notes.title: Logging issues and an Update on what to expect
notes.content:
Hello Midgardians, 

It's been a bit since we've sat down and talked about what's going on with Ragnarok Online 2.  For those who are still with us, you'll notice we finally got an event up!  

That's right we finally got the Valentines Day Event up so that you can finally turn in those chocolates you've been holding on to for the past couple of years. ːsteamhappyː

Though with it, are some interesting side effects.  You also may have seen a familiar NPC in Prontera: 

The Rice Cake Fairy 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4446288/1b0a38ce5e25c638ce04f4e0756fc1ecc39fcc49.jpg[/img]
 

 Better known for their roll in the Jawaii Event.  Unfortunately, this was unintentional, and this particular event was not meant to be activated.  However, as the character was not breaking the game and has all around been missed, we decided to leave it in the game for now, till we figure out why it activated in the first place.  So if you attempt to go to the NPC and realize that you cannot turn in anything, that is why.  

However what is activated is the Valentine's Event!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4446288/be23ed71a5cb405bbd12601da473a93afa26cc4a.jpg[/img]

And with it a slew of sales in the Kafra Shop!  So feel free to check that out the next time you log in. 

This event will be going till March 7th and should be fully functional at this time.

As for other issues that have popped up, if you are having trouble accessing the game we have created a new build and you may need to[b] completely uninstall the game, clear your cache on your browser, then reinstall the game[/b].  This should resolve the [b]Error 02 issue[/b] that has been popping up.  
 
In regards to Ragnarok Online 2 itself, we are hoping that this year we will be able to reactive all of your favorite seasonal events.  We know you have been asking about them in the past, and we are doing everything we can to make sure that happens this year.  

 

Sincerely, 

CM Varitas 

 

P.S.  We are aware that Prontera is still playing Christmas Music, but if you wait long enough it will be thematically appropriate again!   :heh:

notes.title: Elemento Art Academy Art Contest!
notes.content:
Elemento Academy Art Contest!
April 19th – 30th

Elemento Academy is hosting an art contest for all who wish to participate! 



Will you and your friends go exploring the Cursed Ghost Ship or hang out in Prontera? Is your favorite enemy a Poring? Use your artistic skills to share what you like about Ragnarok Online 2!

[b]Entries[/b]

Entries will be accepted from April 19th – April 30th, 2021 

[b]Entry Instructions[/b]

There will be two categories for entries:

[b]Original Art[/b]

Enter a new, originally created piece of art. Draw, paint, sculpt... any way your heart desires! As long as it can be captured in an image and is created by you!

[b]Screenshot/Concept Art[/b]

Would you rather share your artistic vision through an edited screenshot, collage, or blend of concept art and in-game screenshots? This is the category for you!

[b]All Entries[/b]

Must include a Ragnarok theme AND a brief description of your favorite thing about Ragnarok Online 2!

[b]Winners[/b]

There will be at least one grand prize winner per category!  1 Merlion Mount and 7Days VIP!

[b]Participation[/b]

Each participant will receive 2x April Happy Hour Box.

[b]Rules[/b]

One entry per person.

Entries must be posted as a reply to WarpPortal Forums under RO2 News and Events.

Entries must be suitable for all audiences.

[b]Entry Format[/b]

Please use this format when submitting an entry:

[b]In-game Name:[/b]
[b]Link to Image:[/b]
[b]Additional Text:[/b] (Description, story, etc. Anything included here will be used in the judging of your entry when determining grand prizes).

Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: Clue Pursue!
notes.content:
March 15th – March 19th, 2021

5:00 PM PDT – 6:00 PM PDT

Let’s celebrate the weekend with a little game of good old-fashioned Hide N Seek.  Starting March 15th through March 19th we challenge you to find us In-Game for a chance at nifty little gifts! 

How to play? 

    Join us in-game at 5:00 PM PDT then wait for clues on Social Media.   

        What could the clues be? 
[list]
[*]             Screenshots
[*]             Riddles
[*]             Descriptions
[/list]

    Once the first clue is up, the game is on!  

    First person who finds us and initiates a trade with their friendly neighborhood CM wins!   

    After that we will disappear and hide again, and thus the game continues till the stroke of 6:00 PM.

What are the Prizes? 

[b]    March Happy Hour Box! 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4446288/58e9dc34da7e64beddfb62cb5430eb4b814cba4d.jpg[/img]

[b]    As many times as, you can find us![/b]

notes.title: Warpportal Games and Services Downtime
notes.content:
On [b]February 24,2020 - February 26th, 2020[/b] the Warpportal team will be moving our system servers to a new location which is a process that will unfortunately cause all [u]Warpportal Games and Services (websites, support systems) to be offline[/u].

Services will begin being affected on [b]February 24th starting at 10 AM PST[/b], and be completely offline by 11 AM PST. We expect to be online again by [b]Wednesday February 26th at 6PM PST[/b], and will post updates to our social media once everything is back online. We apologize for any inconvenience this downtime will cause and will be posting updates closer to the time this move will occur as well.

notes.title: Patch Notes: April 30, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LHeMQSk.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes: April 30, 2018[/h1]
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GWvzVz4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Happy 5th Anniversary, Ragnarok 2![/h1]

Five years have gone by so quickly! Whether you're a long-time player or have joined us just recently, we would like to thank you for being a part of our wonderful community!

We have been busy working on some great updates this year, and we're so happy to announce that our Anniversary Event will include the first phase of a new system we're very excited about!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8nt5bIS.jpg[/img]
[h1]Cute Pet System: Introduction[/h1]


The Kafra Service and Professor Yggdrasil have been hard at work finding a way to summon monsters to your side, not to assist in battle, but to be your steadfast companion. We are proud to announce that the first phase of the Cute Pet System is ready just in time for our 5th Anniversary Celebration!


Collect DNA, create and incubate Pet Eggs, and make a friend that will provide you with a buff and follow you all day long!


As a special reward for trying the Cute Pet System during our 5th Anniversary Event, we have created a 5th Anniversary Moonlight Flower cute pet with a special buff and unique aura. This pet will only be available during the 5th Anniversary Event!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lipavy8.gif[/img]

For more information: https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/235864-guide-cute-pet-system-introduction/

For a complete guide to the 5th Anniversary Quests: https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/235827-ragnarok-2-5th-anniversary-celebration/

[img]https://i.imgur.com/N78zTAV.jpg[/img]
[h1]Are you ready to hunt an Enraged Moonlight Flower!? You better bring a party![/h1]


Enraged Moonlight Flower will be spawning in the South Plains, Maple Forest, and Sograt Desert! This special boss will provide EVERYONE in the party with personal loot consisting of Unhatched Moonlight Flower Egg, 15x Shiny 5th Anniversary Badges, or Hatched Moonlight Flower Egg. 


To make the most of this boss, join a group to battle it. Enraged Moonlight Flower will respawn every 3 hours. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WCE6y4X.jpg[/img]
[h1]5th Anniversary Sharing Event[/h1]

May 1 to June 4, 2018

Share Ragnarok 2 and win prizes for the entire server! Throughout the Anniversary Month we'll provide you ways to connect with RO2 and unlock tiers toward rewards for everyone!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4eGq8pg.jpg?1[/img]

April 30, 2018 to May 7, 2018

notes.title: Announcement: Service Change in European Countries
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players,
 
Due to the changes of our company's service policy for the European regions, we are sadden to bring you news that, all games and Warpportal services to the European regions listed below will be terminated on May 25th, 2018.
 
The following European countries will be affected by the termination of service: All the European countries except for Russian Federation and the CIS countries.
 
All Warpportal game access and account access will be blocked by regional IP.  Refunds will be gradually sent for purchases made from February 1st 2018 to April 30th 2018 to those affected by this service termination.
 
We have updated our User Agreement and Privacy Policy to reflect the new changes going forward.
 
We thank you for your patience and understanding.[/h1]

[h1]Giving Thanks: EXP and Drop Event![/h1]
November 20 to December 4, 2017
 
 
It's Thanksgiving, and we're giving thanks to YOU! From November 20 to December 4, 2017, enjoy 500% EXP as well as a brand new Celebration Box that will drop during Happy Hours!
 
Happy Hours are  four times a day:
 
02:00-03:00
08:00-09:00
14:00-15:00
20:00-21:00
 
Celebration Box contains:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RGCjZsZ.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r6SD2Be.jpg[/img]

November 13 to December 18, 2017
 
The changing seasons have brought back powerful beings to the kingdom of Rune-Midgarts, adopting the appearance of well-known Midgartsians who they have deemed worthy. They have returned to test the mettle of the newest crop of heroes, providing trials to any who believe they are fit enough to accomplish them. Perform these trials successfully, and perhaps these powerful beings may adopt your visage in the future.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zhiuJzK.jpg[/img]

[h1]Holiday Loading Screen Contest[/h1]
 
November 9 to December 3, 2017
 
The Holidays are just around the corner! Help Rune Midgarts celebrate with festive new loading screens. Your artistic talent can be showcased in game and will be a gift for all of Ragnarok 2!
 
 
 
[b]Entry Instructions[/b]
 
Format: 1920 x 1080 .JPG
 
Edited screenshot, traditional media or digital software drawings. Content from RO2 screenshots or concept art may be used. Unedited or minimally edited screenshots will not receive participation prizes.
 
[b]Winners[/b]
 
Winners will be chosen based on the quality, thoughtfulness, and spooktacularness. Multiple winners will be chosen, and final count will be determined by number of entries received.
 
Winners will receive:
1x Permanent Polar Bear Mount. 
3x Cheny's Snowflake Box
In addition to participation prize.
 
[b]Participation[/b]
 
Each participant will receive 2x Apple of Idun Prize Box and 1x 3~5 Star DNA Random Box by Cheny.

Price: 10 Kafra Points
 
Corruption has spread through Rune Midgarts as the Nightmare on Prontera Street event begins! Clean up corruption by slaying monsters and collecting Seed of Corruption materials. These materials can be exchanged for more concentrated corruption. The Morningstar event vendor will trade your Corrupt Essence for items, costume boxes, and even a special event title!
 
The Box of Corruption contains Corruption materials that can help you earn these prizes even faster.

October 18 - November 13, 2017
 
Enjoy sale prices so low they're absolutely batty!

An ancient evil has returned to Rune-Midgarts. The Dream Demon has trapped our citizens in a waking nightmare. Once you’ve met the Dream Demon in the past, it is time to use his clues to unlock the story in the future. Travel to Ragnarok 2 where a quest will be waiting for you in the Mailbox.
 
For more information, CLICK HERE: https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/225852-a-nightmare-on-prontera-street/
 
But wait, there's more!
 
Corruption has flooded in to Rune-Midgarts, and you can help clean it up! Collect Corrupt Essence materials from monsters all over the world from now until the end of the event. These Corrupt materials can be traded in for higher ranked materials, and ultimately can be redeemed through the Morningstar NPC near Kirkena in Prontera. Collect 100 Corrupt Essence to earn an additional event title!
 
Corruption Materials can also be obtained through the Box of Corruption available in the Kafra Shop. 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XQpNnuL.png[/img]
New Titles:
 
Enjoy full stats on these titles throughout the event period. Once the event period ends, title stats will be halved.

Stats: +500 HP, +200 Magic Attack, +200 Attack
 
Voidwalker: Earned after completing [Event] Taint Here Anymore.
 
Stats: STR+125 / AGI+125 / INT +125 / WIS +125/ VIT+125/ Defense +250
 
 
Corrupted Spirit: Collect 100 Corrupt Essence, title item purchasable from Morningstar NPC.
 
Stats: HP+700, Attack Power +300, Magic Power + 300, Defense +100, Vigor +50, Penetration +50

Ragnarok Online / Ragnarok 2 Crossover Point Promotion Event!

A Nightmare on Prontera Street has brought the Ragnarok Online and Ragnarok 2 communities together to fight off a mutual foe. As you explore the entire Ragnarok Online saga this month, enjoy point rewards that can be used in your main game! All points spent during the event period will count toward tiers of rewards for Reward Coupons that can be redeemed for bonus points!
 
You will earn a Reward Coupon for each tier you unlock: 
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nzM1Vum.png[/img]
 
Each Reward Coupon will be issued once per account, and Coupon Codes expire one month from delivery date.

notes.title: A Nightmare on Prontera Street
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/600x200nightmare.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Nightmare on Prontera Street[/h1]

[b]October 18 to November 6, 2017[/b]
 
An ancient evil has returned to Rune-Midgarts. The Dream Demon has trapped our citizens in a waking nightmare. The story begins hundreds of years in the past with the mysterious playwright Cres Wraven in Ragnarok Online and Ragnarok RE:START. Follow the quest and unlock secret clues that will take you into the future with Ragnarok Online 2. Use the clues from the past and future to complete the quests and earn fantastic rewards for both games!
 
[b]To begin your quest, make your way to Ces Wraven in the Prontera Inn of Ragnarok Online or Ragnarok RE:START. The nightmare will begin in the time of Ragnarok Online, and there you will meet the demon that is haunting your dreams.[/b]
 
 
Once you’ve met the Dream Demon in the past, it is time to use his clues to unlock the story in the future. Travel to Ragnarok 2 where a quest will be waiting for you in the Mailbox.
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/k0HWy0p.jpg[/img]
 
Upon accepting this quest, you will be directed toward modern-day Kirkena outside of an Inn in Prontera. Have you fallen asleep? Oh no, you should have listened to our advice. Be sure you have completed the Ragnarok Online or Ragnarok RE:START quest chain before you proceed.
 
After talking to Kirkena you will be ported to Payon Forest and introduced to the Little Devil. Use the clues from the past to unlock the next portion of the quest chain with the Little Devil.
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sN65JZ5.jpg[/img]
 
If you answer his questions correctly, you will be directed to seek out the Restless Spirits that haunt the Payon Forest graveyard.
 
Pay close attention to the clues the spirits provide you with. You will need them as you move forward.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NrSrt4c.jpg[/img]
 
If you choose correctly, you will be provided with an item to summon the Dream Demon. If you succeed, you will be granted the event title of Haunted.
 
Upon completion of this section of the quest chain, Kirkena will discuss the clues with you and direct you to seek answers in your past.
 
[b]To continue, you must pick up where you left off in Ragnaork Online or Ragnarok RE:START.[/b]

Kirkena will direct you to battle the demons that are invading the South Plains of Prontera. These demons hold special clues that will help you solve the mystery of the Dream Demon. Retrieve them and return to Kirkena.
 
Use the information from the completed quests in Ragnarok Online or Ragnarok RE:START to decipher the clues. 
 
Now that you have unlocked the secrets of the past and the future, you are ready to fight the Dream Demon and his Risen Generals. Proceed to the Event Zone by speaking to Kirkena. Meet her outside of Baphomet's Chamber to face the Demons of your nightmares and seal off the rift that is allowing corruption to leak into Rune-Midgarts. 
 
Completing this portion of the quest chain will reward you with the Voidwalker event title and Halloween costume items! You can continue to cleanse the corruption from the world by collecting Seed of Corruption from fallen monsters and returning them to Kirkena's minion, Morningstar, for useful rewards.

[h1]Ragnarok 2: Summer Sharing  [/h1]
Connect With Ragnarok 2 and Win a Month of Experience and Bonus Rewards!
 
 
From August 8 to September 11, join the fun, connect with Ragnarok 2, and earn fantastic prizes and events for the entire server! Each entry received will help unlock server-wide prizes including experience bonuses, items, and events!
 
[h1]Details[/h1]
 
Every entry counts toward a Grand Prize and Rewards for the Entire Server! Entries will be counted throughout the event period, and prizes will be distributed to the entire server after a tier is unlocked. At the end of the event, five winners will be chosen for the Grand Prize!

[b]This Week's Tier Rewards: 12,000* Entry Tier Unlocked[/b]

[h1]Ragnarok 2: Summer Sharing  [/h1]
Connect With Ragnarok 2 and Win a Month of Experience and Bonus Rewards!
 
 
From August 8 to September 11, join the fun, connect with Ragnarok 2, and earn fantastic prizes and events for the entire server! Each entry received will help unlock server-wide prizes including experience bonuses, items, and events!

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
- Guardian Rune: Resolved issue where some versions of Guardian Rune were not working correctly.
- Emergency Recall: Must now be used 30 meters away from any gate in WoE.
- Jehoon Wall Jump: Can no longer use skills until gate goes down.
- Ymir Form: You will no longer remain targeted if you use Hide or die while in Ymir Form.
- Happy Hour Duration: Happy Hour now appropriately lasts 1 hour. 
- WoE Orb: Can no longer be activated while dead.
- Protection Stone: Now protects only members of the guild activating it. 
- Crossbow no longer ignores Divine Hemisphere.
- Channel 10: Resolved issue with inviting characters in this channel.
- Death Penalty: Master Level death penalty has been changed so that level-appropriate MP is lost. 
- Death Penalty: MP can no longer be lost in Alberta, Morroc, Prontera, Prontera Battlefield, and Morroc Fortress.
- Resolved issue with channel crashing.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]

[h1] Patch Notes June 26, 2017
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/o1hmocX.png[/img]

[b]We're celebrating Independence by having an Independence Sale![/b]
Sale Period: June 26 - July 6, 2017

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XP0ydwt.png[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/4thofJulyScreenshot_datechange.jpg[/img]

[b]4th of July Screenshot Contest[/b]

Event Period: June 26 - July 17, 2017

While we celebrate our Independence Day in the United States, we want to extend the festivities to everyone! No matter where you are from, let’s party and get some amazing In-Game Screenshots. Find some friends, or strangers, to set a party scene with you and take some amazing screenshots to share your party with the world!

[b]Entries[/b]

Entries will be accepted from 6/26/2017 to 7/17/2017.

[b]Entry Instructions[/b]

Entering is easy. 
[olist]
[*] Find a group, set a festive scene, and take screenshots of your Independence Day party!
[list]
[*] To help with the decor, we are sending out a few USA Flag Capes in Celebration of the Holiday!
[*] Capes are being sent to all those who have signed-in in the last 6 months and have clocked at least 72 hours of game play. 
[/list]
[*] Take pictures and find your favorite. 
[*] Post your favorite to this thread with your IGN.
[*] At the end of the event the entries will be compiled and voted on by the 
Warpportal staff. 
[/olist]

[b]Prizes[/b]

[b]1st Prize:[/b]

[list]
[*] Apple of Idun
[*] 7 D VIP
[*] 1 Rune Remover
[*] Swag Box

[/list]


[b]2nd Prize:[/b]

[list]
[*] 7 D VIP
[*] 1 Rune Remover
[*] Swag Box
[/list]


[b]3rd Prize:[/b]

[list]
[*] 3 Day VIP
[*] 1 Rune Remover
[*] Swag Box
[/list]


[b]Participation Prize[/b]

[list]
[*] Phantom Pyramid Stone
[/list]

[b]Rules[/b]

List the rules of the event. Typically these will suffice:
[olist]
[*]To qualify, entries must follow the requirements listed under “Entry Instructions”
[*] One entry per person. Entering the contest on more than one character or account will result in disqualification.
[*] Please remember to keep entries suitable for all audiences. Offensive entries will be removed. 
[/olist]

[b]To Enter[/b]


Check out the forum topic [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/214741-4th-of-july-screenshot-contest/?p=2631270]HERE[/url]!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kPNBLlS.jpg[/img]
[h1]Interface Design: Kafra Surgeon[/h1]
Event Period: June 12 to July 31, 2017

The Kafra Service is proud to offer appearance and gender customization through the Kafra Surgeon NPC. To show our thanks for all of the Kafra Service's hard work, we have decided to create a background for the Kafra Surgeon's window! The winning entry will have their artwork immortalized in game as the new background for the customization window.

[b]Winner[/b]
The Grand Prize winner will be chosen by staff vote. This winner will receive the following prizes in addition to the participation prize.

[b]Winners will receive:[/b]

In addition to having their work immortalized in game, item prizes include:

[b]2x[/b] Appearance Change Tickets
[b]2x[/b] 3s Costume of Choice (Including Swag/Kafra and new 3s Purple Slot Costumes!)

[b]Participation[/b]
Each participant will receive 1x Appearance Change Ticket and 2x Apple of Idun prize boxes.


To learn more and submit your entry, visit the event post [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/213686-community-event-interface-design-kafra-surgeon/]HERE![/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dimeiuy.png[/img]
[h1]Ragnarok 2: Past, Present, Future[/h1]
[b]Video Contest[/b]
Event Period: May 15 - June 26

Four years of Ragnarok 2, and each of you have left a lasting impression on the history of the game. Anniversaries are a time of reflection, and in this video creation event we invite you to tell us about your special moments in Ragnarok 2.

[b]Entry Instructions[/b] 
Entries will be in video format.

[b]Winners[/b]
The videos that best show passion, enthusiasm, effort, and creativity will be selected as grand prize winners.  Grand prize winners will receive the participation reward as well as:

[b]One of Each:[/b]
3 Slot Upper, or Middle, or Lower Face accessory item of your choice
3 Slot Kafra or Swag or body costume item of your choice

[b]Each qualifying participant will receive 5x Cheny's Sunshine Box.[/b]

For more information and to submit your entry, visit the event post: [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/211705-community-event-ragnarok-2-past-present-future-video-contest/] HERE! [/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes: June 19, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes June 19, 2017
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0ZrgUcJ.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nGC158s.jpg[/img]
[h1]Character Appearance and Gender Customization[/h1]

Change is good! Tired of the same old face, eyes, hair, voice, or even gender? Thanks to fantastic advancements in technology, the Kafra Service is now able to provide Appearance and Gender Customization!

[b]Getting Started[/b]

To begin, visit the Kafra Surgeon in Prontera.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jf2BzFv.jpg[/img]

In order to meet her requirements, you will need to prepare a few things:
[list]
[*]Remove all gender-specific gear.
[*]Cancel any type of transformation spell.
[*]Carry an [b]Appearance Change Ticket[/b]
[/list]

[b]Appearance Change Ticket:[/b] Allows removal of your appearance's pre-existing condition! Take this Appearance Change Ticket to the Kafra Surgeon in order to change your appearance or gender. 

The [b]Appearance Change Ticket[/b] can be purchased from the Kafra Shop and can be sold, traded, and auctioned. 

With your Appearance Change Ticket in your inventory, and all other requirements met, the Kafra Surgeon will display this dialogue box:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CkDNWiM.png[/img]

Press the [b]Appearance[/b] button to open the customization interface. You can use the + and - buttons on the bottom of the window to zoom into a particular feature or zoom out to view your entire character. As you scroll through the options available to your character, they will automatically be shown in the interface. Experiment with different combinations until you find the style that suits you perfectly!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nLbsLWX.png[/img]

If you're feeling even more daring, you can change your gender at the same time that you customize other parts of your appearance. Press the [b]OK! Let's go![/b] button to complete your selection.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qCbGo53.png[/img]

The Appearance Change Ticket will be consumed, and your character will automatically update according to the selections that you have made. 

We hope you enjoy using the new Kafra Surgeon! If you need more information or would like to see an example of the process, please view the video below:

https://youtu.be/1JnegrBzDac

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lnHmL68.jpg[/img]
[h1]Time to Expand Your Wardrobe![/h1]

Want purple runeholes in your costume, but don't want to look like a Kafra employee? Not feeling the Swag? Well, you're in luck! A new set of vendors have joined Cheny in Prontera, and they bring with them the ability to exchange your old costume items for shiny new purple-slotted versions! 

[b]To Begin...[/b]

Find the NPC that is appropriate for your costume type:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4nBWhDM.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Tijera, Unisex Costumes
[*]Hasami, Female Costumes
[*]Forbici, Male Costumes
[*]Scissors, Platinum and Union Costumes
[*]Gawi, RO1 Costumes
[/list]

You will need:
[list]
[*]3-slot version of a grey runehole costume
[*]20,000 Diamonds
[/list]

Each vendor has a vast selection of costumes. Find your costume on the list to exchange the 3-slot version and 20,000 diamonds for a new 3-slot purple runehole version!

[b]Important Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Dye will not transfer.
[*]Please remove any runes that you would like to keep. Runes and Runeholes will not be transferred.
[*]RO1 statted costumes do not have a statted version with purple runeholes. 
[/list]
For more information and to see this new feature in action, take a moment to watch our preview video:

https://youtu.be/vX4su0qhtv8

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4eGq8pg.jpg?1[/img]
[h1]It's time for June's Happy Hour Boxes![/h1]
[i]Event Period: June 19 - June 26, 2017[/i]

Happy Hour Boxes drop four times a day:
[list]
[*]02:00-03:00
[*]08:00-09:00
[*]14:00-15:00
[*]20:00-21:00
[/list] 
Players have a chance to get an additional box drop during this time by farming monsters within a five level range of the player that will randomly pop out a useful item.

Box has a chance to drop one of the following items:
[list]
[*]The Chance Coupon
[*]2 Thief Potions
[*]Card Coating Paper
[*]Divine Protection
[*]Large Bag
[*]Master Battle Manual Order
[*]Graham Potion
[*]Premium Dye
[*]Phantom Stone
[*]Event Random Box II
[*]Special Honing Oil (5%)
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kPNBLlS.jpg[/img]
[h1]Interface Design: Kafra Surgeon[/h1]
[i]Event Period: June 12 to July 31[/i]

The Kafra Service is proud to offer appearance and gender customization through the Kafra Surgeon NPC. To show our thanks for all of the Kafra Service's hard work, we have decided to create a background for the Kafra Surgeon's window! The winning entry will have their artwork immortalized in game as the new background for the customization window.

[b]Winner[/b]

The Grand Prize winner will be chosen by staff vote. This winner will receive the following prizes in addition to the participation prize.

[b]Winners will receive:[/b]
[i]In addition to having their work immortalized in game, item prizes include:[/i]

2x Appearance Change Tickets
2x 3s Costume of Choice (Including Swag/Kafra and new 3s Purple Slot Costumes!)

[b]Participation[/b]

Each participant will receive 1x Appearance Change Ticket and 2x Apple of Idun prize boxes.

To learn more and submit your entry, visit the event post [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/213686-community-event-interface-design-kafra-surgeon/]HERE![/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dimeiuy.png[/img]
[h1]Ragnarok 2: Past, Present, Future[/h1]
[b]Video Contest[/b]
[i]Event Period: May 15 - June 26[/i]

Four years of Ragnarok 2, and each of you have left a lasting impression on the history of the game. Anniversaries are a time of reflection, and in this video creation event we invite you to tell us about your special moments in Ragnarok 2.

Entries will be in video format.

For more information and to submit your entry, visit the event post: [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/211705-community-event-ragnarok-2-past-present-future-video-contest/]HERE![/url]

Want purple runeholes in your costume, but don't want to look like a Kafra employee? Not feeling the Swag? Well, you're in luck! A new set of vendors have joined Cheny in Prontera, and they bring with them the ability to exchange your old costume items for shiny new purple-slotted versions! 

[b]To Begin...[/b]
Find the NPC that is appropriate for your costume type:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4nBWhDM.png[/img]

 
[list]
[*]Tijera, Unisex Costumes
[*]Hasami, Female Costumes
[*]Forbici, Male Costumes
[*]Scissors, Platinum and Union Costumes
[*]Gawi, RO1 Costumes
[/list]
 
[b]You will need:[/b]
3-slot version of a grey runehole costume
20,000 Diamonds

Each vendor has a vast selection of costumes. Find your costume on the list to exchange the 3-slot version and 20,000 diamonds for a new 3-slot purple runehole version!

[list]

notes.title: [Guide] Kafra Surgeon: Character Appearance and Gender Customization
notes.content:
[h1]Coming June 2017![/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nGC158s.jpg[/img]

[h1]Kafra Surgeon[/h1]
[b]Character Appearance and Gender Customization[/b]

Change is good! Tired of the same old face, eyes, hair, voice, or even gender? Thanks to fantastic advancements in technology, the Kafra Service is now able to provide Appearance and Gender Customization!
 
[b]Getting Started[/b]
 
To begin, visit the Kafra Surgeon in Prontera.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jf2BzFv.jpg[/img]

In order to meet her requirements, you will need to prepare a few things:
* Remove all gender-specific gear.
* Cancel any type of transformation spell.
* Carry an Appearance Change Ticket


[b]Appearance Change Ticket:[/b] Allows removal of your appearance's pre-existing condition! Take this Appearance Change Ticket to the Kafra Surgeon in order to change your appearance or gender. 
 
The Appearance Change Ticket can be purchased from the Kafra Shop and can be sold, traded, and auctioned. 
 
With your Appearance Change Ticket in your inventory, and all other requirements met, the Kafra Surgeon will display this dialogue box:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CkDNWiM.png[/img]

Press the [b]Appearance[/b]  button to open the customization interface. You can use the + and - buttons on the bottom of the window to zoom into a particular feature or zoom out to view your entire character. As you scroll through the options available to your character, they will automatically be shown in the interface. Experiment with different combinations until you find the style that suits you perfectly!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nLbsLWX.png[/img]

If you're feeling even more daring, you can change your gender at the same time that you customize other parts of your appearance. Press the[b] OK! Let's go! [/b] button to complete your selection.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qCbGo53.png[/img]

The Appearance Change Ticket will be consumed, and your character will automatically update according to the selections that you have made. 
 
We hope you enjoy using the new Kafra Surgeon! If you need more information or would like to see an example of the process, please view the video below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1JnegrBzDac

[h1]Patch Notes June 12, 2017
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.

[h1]Interface Design: Kafra Surgeon[/h1]
[b]June 12 to July 31[/b]

The Kafra Service is proud to offer appearance and gender customization through the Kafra Surgeon NPC. To show our thanks for all of the Kafra Service's hard work, we have decided to create a background for the Kafra Surgeon's window! The winning entry will have their artwork immortalized in game as the new background for the customization window.
 
[b]Winner[/b]
The Grand Prize winner will be chosen by staff vote. This winner will receive the following prizes in addition to the participation prize.
 
[b]Winners will receive:[/b]
In addition to having their work immortalized in game, item prizes include:
 
2x Appearance Change Tickets
2x 3s Costume of Choice (Including Swag/Kafra and new 3s Purple Slot Costumes!)
 
 
[b]Participation[/b]
Each participant will receive 1x Appearance Change Ticket and 2x Apple of Idun prize boxes.
 
To learn more and submit your entry, visit the event post [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/213686-community-event-interface-design-kafra-surgeon/]HERE![/url]
 
To learn more about the Kafra Surgeon update, [b]coming June 2017[/b], check out this preview video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1JnegrBzDac

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FzCR1RB.jpg[/img]
[h1]Ragnarok 2: Past, Present, Future[/h1]
[b]Video Contest![/b]

[b]May 15 to June 26[/b]

Four years of Ragnarok 2, and each of you have left a lasting impression on the history of the game. Anniversaries are a time of reflection, and in this video creation event we invite you to tell us about your special moments in Ragnarok 2. 

[b]Entry Instructions[/b]
Entries will be in video format, publicly posted to YouTube.

[b]Winners[/b]
The videos that best show passion, enthusiasm, effort, and creativity will be selected as grand prize winners.  Grand prize winners will receive the participation prize as well as:
 
[b]One of each:[/b]
3 Slot Upper, or Middle, or Lower Face accessory item of your choice
3 Slot Kafra or Swag or body costume item of your choice

[b]Each qualifying participant will receive 5x Cheny's Sunshine Box .[/b]

[url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/211705-community-event-ragnarok-2-past-present-future-video-contest/]For more information or to submit your video, click here![/url]

[h1]Patch Notes May 10, 2017
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)[/h1]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[h1]Ragnarok 2: 4th Anniversary Festivities!
Connect With Ragnarok 2 and Win a Month of Experience and Bonus Rewards![/h1]

From May 1 to June 5, join the fun, connect with Ragnarok 2, and earn fantastic prizes and events for the entire server! Each entry received will help unlock server-wide prizes including experience bonuses, items, and events!

[b]Prizes Unlocked: Week 1[/b]
[list]
[*]Divine Protection x3
[*]Master Battle Manual Order x3
[*]Rune Remover by Cheny x2
[*]Rune Random Box x2
[*]Phantom Stone x3
[*]Pandora’s Key by Cheny x3
[*]Chance Coupon x5
[*]Rune Slot Accessory Puncher by Cheny

400% Experience!

These serverwide prizes will be shared with everyone! To continue earning prizes, be sure to visit the event page for [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/211003-ragnarok-2-4th-anniversary-festivities/]Ragnarok 2: 4th Anniversary Festivities![/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes: May 1, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[b]Patch Notes May 1, 2017[/b]
[i]Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.[/i]
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0ZrgUcJ.png[/img]
[b]Leprechaun's Fan Club![/b]

Visit Kafra Einsope in Prontera to start a new set of quests that let you get to know Cheny, Leprechaun, and their crew (plus you get some diamonds as well)!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SGdMfzI.gif[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hm63Ade.jpg[/img]
It's been four years!  Can you believe it?  In honor of this momentous occassion we have a new quest just for you!
 
You may begin your quest at this mysterious mailbox.  Where you may begin your adventure with, [b]"Call From a Friend."[/b] 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/1_mapandmailbox.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/1_callfromafrend.jpg[/img]

Memories abound as you find yourself treading on familiar ground, Prontera! Where you must speak with [b]Zeras Hyperion[/b].

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2_MapandNPC.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2_quest.jpg[/img]
 
What antics could these NPC's possibly be up to?  Your next step will be back in [b]Alberta[/b] with [b]Maden[/b].

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/3_NPCandMap.jpg[/img]  

Who will then direct you to visit [b]Aione[/b].

[img] http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/3_Quest2.jpg [/img]

[img] http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/4_NPCandmap.jpg [/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/4_Quest.jpg[/img]
 
Once you have spoken to the illustrious Aione it is back to Maden who has more than just a few quests in store. 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/3_NPCandMap.jpg [/img]  
 
Thus begins your quest through memory lane to collect the Memory Stones!

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/6_DailyQuests.jpg[/img]
 
With the stones you may collect Birthday Present Tickets that can then be traded to Menille for nifty prizes!

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/7_NPCandmap.jpg[/img]
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/7_itemlist1.jpg[/img][img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/7_itemlist2.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the memories one Dungeon at a time! 
 
[b]Ragnarok 2: 4th Anniversary Festivities![/b]

[i]Connect With Ragnarok 2 and Win a Month of Experience and Bonus Rewards![/i]
Event Period: May 1 - June 5, 2017
 
From May 1 to June 5, join the fun, connect with Ragnarok 2, and earn fantastic prizes and events for the entire server! Each entry received will help unlock server-wide prizes including experience bonuses, items, and events!
 
[b]Details[/b]
 
Every entry counts toward a Grand Prize and Rewards for the Entire Server! Entries will be counted throughout the event period, and prizes will be distributed to the entire server after a tier is unlocked. At the end of the event, five winners will be chosen for the Grand Prize!
 
[b]Grand Prize[/b]
 
[b]Grand Prize Reward Package Contains:[/b]
 
Cheny's Soul x5
Cheny's Sunshine Box x5
Cheny's Snowflake Box x5
 
[b]and[/b]
 
One 3-Slot Costume Item of Your Choice! For multiple-piece costumes, one piece from the set can be chosen. 
 
Five (5) winners will be contacted through email, so please remember to enter using a valid email address!
 
[b]Server Prizes[/b]
 
Every entry counts toward a tier to unlock. [b]Once unlocked, everyone who logged in during the week (the period between regular maintenance) for at least one hour will be eligible to receive the prize.[/b] For example, if 2,000 entries are received during the first week, the first maintenance will increase experience to 200% and distribute the prizes to the temporary storage of anyone who had a qualifying log in. [b]The next week, you will have to log in again at least one hour (account-wide, uninterrupted) to receive the item prizes that unlock. [/b] Server-wide bonuses such as events and experience are applied automatically to everyone. 
 
[b]Prize Tiers[/b]
[i]1,000 Entries[/i]
Divine Protection x3
Master Battle Manual Order x3

[i]2,000 Entries[/i]
200% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]3,000 Entries[/i]
Rune Remover by Cheny x2
Rune Random Box x2

[i]4,000 Entries[/i]
300% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]5,000 Entries[/i]
 
Phantom Stone x3
Pandora’s Key by Cheny x3
Chance Coupon x5

[i]5,500 Entries[/i]
Return of Happy Hour Boxes for one week!
[b]July Happy Hour Box containing:[/b]
The Chance Coupon
Thief Potion
Card Coating Paper
Divine Protection
Large Bag
Master Battle Manual Order (30 min)
Graham Potion
Premium Dye
Premium Designated Dye
Blessing Powder
Complete Honing Scrub
Event Reward Random Box II

[i]6,000 Entries[/i]
Rune Slot Accessory Puncher by Cheny
3~5 Star DNA Random Box by Cheny
 
[i]7,000 Entries[/i]
400% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]8,000 Entries[/i]
Seals! Two each Cheny Seals:
Vulcan, Veriel, Hoeneim, Demeter, and Guardian.

[i]9,000 Entries[/i]
500% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]10,000 Entries[/i]
Swag Boxes will drop during HHB hours for one week! 
Thief Potion x5
If Happy Hour is currently enabled, Swag Drops will be delayed until the next available week.

[i]10,500 Entries[/i]
600% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]11,000 Entries[/i]
Special Honing Oil 15%
Precise Honing Hammer
Complete Honing Scrub

[i]12,000 Entries[/i]
700% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]13,000 Entries[/i]
 
Infinium x2
Blessing Powder x2
Refinement Transfer Ticket
 

[i]13,500 Entries[/i]
800% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]14,000 Entries[/i]
Phantom Stone x5
Graham Potion x5
Explorer's Elixir Package x5
Cheny's Soul

[i]14,500 Entries[/i]
900% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]15,000 Entries[/i]
Rune Remover x2
Honing Scrub x2
Precise Honing Hammer x2
 
[i]15,500 Entries[/i]
1,000% Experience for the entire server, throughout the event.

[i]16,000 Entries[/i]
Return of Happy Hour Boxes for one week! 
[b]Happy Hour Box V Contains:[/b]
Prontera Warp Scroll
Morroc Warp Scroll
Explorer Purple Potion
Infinium
The Chance Coupon
Master Battle Manual Order
Skill Reset Vellum
Rocket Runehole Puncher
Complete Honing Scrub (Event)
Pandora's Key
Phantom Stone
 
[i]17,000 Entries[/i]
Piece of Loki's Aura x10
Piece of Loki's Vanity x10
Piece of Loki's Dress x10
 
[i]18,000 Entries[/i]
DNA Random Box (By Cheny)
3~5 DNA Random Box (By Cheny)
Cheny’s Snowflake Box
 
[i]19,000 Entries[/i]
Rune Fusion Charm
Cosmetic Fusion Tablet
Appearance Fusion Charm
 
[i]20,000 Entries[/i]
Return of Happy Hour Boxes for one week!
Happy Hour Box containing:
Prontera Warp Scroll
Morroc Warp Scroll
Spinel Purple Potion
Pandora's Key
The Chance Coupon
Master Battle Manual Order (30min)
Mystery Chest I
Infinium
Card Coating Paper
Phantom Stone
 
[i]21,000 Entries[/i]
Cheny’s Sunshine Box
Black Magic Aura
 
[i]22,000 Entries[/i]
Extend current EXP rate 1 week past event end!
 
Make sure you use a valid Email address to register. We'll be contacting the 5 Grand Prize winners through email after the event is complete. 
 
To increase the number of entries possible each week, live Twitch live-stream views will count as additional entries. Tune in to have your presence counted! Additionally, a code will be given out at each RO2 Live Stream (Friday at 3PM) to earn you [b]TWO[/b] more entries! Just return to the Gleam campaign page and input the code. 
 
[url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/211003-ragnarok-2-4th-anniversary-festivities/?p=2602947] To Enter Click Here[/url]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/V9RRnTl.jpg[/img]
 
Event Period: May 1 - June 5, 2017
We've put in the Anniversary Loading Screens that won into the game and they'll be running through the duration of our anniversary events! Check it out in-game to see the beautiful artwork our community has delivered!
 
Happy Hour Event
It's time for May's Happy Hour Boxes!
Event Period: May 1 - May 10, 2017
Happy Hour Boxes drop four times a day:

02:00-03:00
08:00-09:00
14:00-15:00
20:00-21:00
 
Players have a chance to get an additional box drop during this time by farming monsters within a five level range of the player that will randomly pop out a useful item.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/aXjGAT0.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/o1hmocX.png[/img]

[b]We're having a Giant Anniversary Sale[/b]
[i]Sale Period: May 1 - June 5, 2017[/i]
Grab your discounted items while we celebrate our fourth anniversary this month!Anniversary Sale

notes.title: [Guide] Goddesses Update: Part One
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/irlelbK.png[/img]
 
 
[i]Long, long ago, in the places we now know as Sograt Desert and Dayr Desert, existed a large and prosperous empire. This was the Solvive Empire, which was ruled by the just and attentive Osiris. Outsiders brought their own beliefs to Solvive, including the two sects known as the Synod of The Dawn and the Twilight Vanguard. These sects worshiped different goddesses. The Synod of the Dawn gave devotion to Sol, the one who bore the heat and the light of day for Midgard. The Twilight Vanguard worshiped Nott, the goddess of the night and darkness. Members of both sects provided animal sacrifices to their goddesses, praying that these offerings would strengthen their chosen deity. Members of the opposing sects were in conflict. The sects fought for their own interests, for longer days or nights. Growing tired of these incessant conflicts, the Solvive Empire ordered both sects to be banished from the kingdom. The Synod and Vanguard were cast from the desert, but the countless statues sculpted in honor of their goddesses left an indelible mark on the landscape.
 
Centuries have passed since the reign of the Solvive Empire, and little has changed. Decades before Surt escaped his seal in Morroc, there was an event that was marked forever in history. For weeks, the night did not appear in Midgard. Historians refer to this period as the "Neverending Sun". Wilted by the endless days, the Synod of The Dawn took responsibility for the neverending sun and proposed a peace agreement with the vanguard of Twilight. The group leaders at the time, Raymond Bazerald for the Synod and Azoth Hinori for the Vanguard, agreed that they would cease their fighting and would dedicate themselves to returning the balance between night and day. In the time after this accord was struck, the nights days and nights have returned to normal and both sects have existed peacefully.
 
311 years after the Day of Despair, the Synod of The Dawn and the Twilight Vanguard have returned to the Dayr Desert for the first time since their banishment-- and they are recruiting new members. Although the statues of their goddesses have been rendered unrecognizable by the harsh passage of time, their passion and devotion to their goddesses has flourished.[/i]
 
[b]Goddesses Update: Part One[/b]
 
The return of the Synod of the Dawn and the Twilight Vanguard marks the beginning of a new adventure for Midgardians. Begin your quest by speaking to [b]Aasland Gunnrod[/b] or [b] Simona LeonHart [/b] in Dayr Desert.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Scyycvy.png[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/uoraJF4.png[/img]
 
Choose wisely, adventurer. Once you accept the quest of one faction you will not be able to join forces with the other. Which path will you follow? Light or dark?
 
Once you decide, continue on to your first quest! As you start out on your path you will find new quests and Offering Scrolls, and can begin earning [b]Goddesses' Token of Gratitude.[/b]
 
[b]Offering Scrolls[/b]
 
Offering Scrolls are Extermination Requests that can be purchased with Zeny or Goddesses' Token of Gratitude. These quests ask you to exterminate certain monsters in exchange for experience and Token rewards. Offering Scroll vendors are located across Dayr Desert, and will be an invaluable addition to your leveling journey.
 
[b]Goddesses' Token of Gratitude[/b]
 
As you fight your way through the desert you will earn the favor of your chosen goddess. As you complete quests and Offering Scroll challenges, you will earn Goddesses' Token of Gratitude. These Token items can be exchanged at with the leader of your faction:
 
[b]Emily Lucine[/b]
 
Leader of the Twilight Vanguard, located in the Pilanium Dead Mine. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/my2SW1Y.png[img]
 
[b]Einar Galf[/b]
 
Acting leader of the Synod of the Dawn, located in the Pilanium Dead Mine.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TbcxwBt.png[/img]
 
Each faction has its own costume and access to special items in addition to the elements. Choose wisely!

notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes March 20, 2017
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)[/h1]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ooeUZ28.jpg[/img]
[h1]Lost Leprechaun: NPC Hunt[/h1]
[i]Event Period: March 8 - March 27, 2017[/i]

[b]Update: We've unlocked 500% EXP bonus this week as a server-wide prize! Those who participated should expect item prizes to be distributed after maintenance, as well![/b]

Oh no! Cheny's pet Leprechaun went out to grab more supplies and seems to have gotten lost! If you help us find him, you and all of your friends will win Cheny's favor... and maybe a pot of gold! Or prizes. Probably prizes. 

The Lost Leprechaun: NPC hunt is a scavenger hunt that will reward hunters with a personal prize as well as server-wide bonuses for finding all of the Leprechaun locations. What's the catch? Well... the clues will be very, very vague. You'll need to do a bit of exploring to find the NPCs each week.
 
[b]Entries[/b]
 
Entries will be accepted from March 8 to March 27.
 
[b]Entry Instructions[/b]
 
Each week, after regular maintenance, I will hide Leprechauns and post a clue. The clue will give you a vague idea of where they are, and will let you know how many Leprechauns are missing. 

To enter, post a screenshot of your character with the Leprechaun. Screenshot can be edited to just show you and the Leprechaun's location. Post your screenshot and the details below as a reply to this post.

[b]In-game name:

Link to image:[/b] (please use Imgur or some other public image hosting site. No Facebook links.)

[b]Map and location: 


Winners[/b]
 
We're all winners! Find all of the Leprechauns each week to win server-wide prizes. 

[b]To qualify for item prizes, you must be logged in at least 1 hour during the week, and that time cannot be interrupted. So maintain a log in on one character for  at least an hour each week to qualify for these prizes.
 
Participation[/b]
 
If you are the first to find a Leprechaun and post it, you will earn 1x Cheny's Soul in addition to the server-wide bonus that is unlocked if all Leprechauns are found.
 
[b]Rules[/b]
 
Entries must follow the entry format posted above. Image of the Leprechaun must be included. Post only 1 Leprechaun per reply. If you find more than one, make a new post. To keep the hunt fair, edited posts will not be eligible for prizes. 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
- We've resolved a duplicate character name issue, caused from past services merging into ours, that caused issues with mail and friends lists.

In honor of Ragnarok 2's anniversary we will be updating the loading screens to show off your artistic talent! Share a picture of Ragnarok 2 that you have created yourself. Entries will be accepted from March 6 to April 10. 
 
Entry Instructions

Edited screenshot, traditional media or digital software drawings. Content from RO2 screenshots or concept art may be used.

Winners will be chosen based on the quality, thoughtfulness, and celebratory feel. Multiple winners will be chosen, and final count will be determined by number of entries received.

From February 6 to March 6, join the fun, connect with Ragnarok 2, and earn fantastic prizes and events for the entire server! Each entry received will help unlock server-wide prizes including experience bonuses, items, and events!
 
[b]Details[/b]
Every entry counts toward a Grand Prize and Rewards for the Entire Server! Entries will be counted throughout the event period, and prizes will be distributed to the entire server after a tier is unlocked. At the end of the event, five winners will be chosen for the Grand Prize!
 
[b]Server Prizes[/b]
Every entry counts toward a tier unlock. Once unlocked, everyone who logged in during the week (the period between regular maintenance) for at least one hour will be eligible to receive the prize. For example, if 2,000 entries are received during the first week, the first maintenance will increase experience to 200% and distribute the prizes to the temporary storage of anyone who had a qualifying log in. The next week, you will have to log in again at least one hour (account-wide, uninterrupted) to receive the item prizes that unlock. notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes January 18, 2017
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)[/h1]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[h1]The Lunar Festival is here![/h1]
[i]Event Period: January 18 - February 13, 2017[/i]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/lunarfestival600.png[/img]
An Icy wind has blown in from the North! Monsters are freezing around Rune-Midgarts and inhabitants need your help to deal with this cold snap!

Collect bottled lightening from the main and daily quests to trade in for items!

Start your quest journey at NPC Gale in Prontera with a level 15 character or higher.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Gale.jpg[/img]

Find NPC Huginn in the center of Prontera to exchange your bottled lightning for items.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Huginn.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/kafrashop.png[/img]
[h1]Lunar Festival Boxes are here![/h1]
[i]Shop Period: January 18 - February 13, 2017[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/X19UXwZ.png[/img]
This will have a random chance to drop one of the following costumes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Rgrxukk.png[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MvbKCR2.png[/img]
This will have a random chance to drop one of the following accessories:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yUGqJA0.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/YxUktLp.png[/img]
This will have a random chance to drop one of the following mounts:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/T3uF1dJ.png[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Changes.png[/img]
[h1]New Guild Skill: Siege Weaponry![/h1]
There is a new guild skill for guilds to use siege weaponry in War of Emperium maps.
Gather the new guild skill books to unlock all five tiers!

[b]Guild Skill: Siege Weaponry:[/b]
[list]
[*](5) Tiers that allow you to unlock 10/20/30/40/50 siege weapons to be used on the map
[*]New Siege Hammer item for sale at Siege Weapon vendors that allow guilds to destroy their own siege and coordinate their siege placement better
[*]New Siege Weaponry radius has been extended from 6m to 10m
[*]Siege Weapon build cooldown has been extended from 3 seconds to 10 seconds
[*]Incomplete siege weapons will self-destruct after 30 seconds unless used or completed
[*]New error messages for Siege Hammer if siege weapon is in use, or if a guild is at their siege weaponry limit
[*]New buff icon to show current siege weapon limit
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Yule Festival has ended
[*]Right-hand side Trade Window was previously unprotected from a trade scam and this has been fixed.
[*]New UI menu option for Card Reinforcement
[/list]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Resolved issue where wrong character might be deleted if you scrolled left with three pages of characters
[*]Pet names in Monster Collection should now be sorted alphabetically
[*]Resolved an issue so that using tab while in the auction house will not cause a failed registration issue
[*]Resolved an issue where force closing the game bypassed using Spinels or other related items
[*]Invincibility Buff in PvP should now also extend to damage-over-time or debuffs
[*]GreenSeed Rune effects showed anincomplete description in gear and the effect of the rune should now appear correctly in gear
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: December 5, 2016
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes December 5, 2016
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 3pm-7pm PDT (~4 hours)[/h1]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Changes.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9LJO5OM.jpg[/img]
[h1]Cosmetic Fusion System Update Guide
December 2016[/h1]

Fusing your favorite costumes has just gotten a lot easier! In this Cosmetic Fusion System Update, you can decide what you would like the outcome of your fusion to be. All cosmetic items, including back, face accessories, head/hat items, and body costumes are fused using the same tablet. Use this tablet to combine any normal cosmetic items together to create the type of costume you need!

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]All cosmetic items now use the same tablet. No more Costume Fusion Tablet and Accessory Fusion Tablet distinctions.
[*]Existing Costume and Accessory Fusion Tablets are automatically updated to the new Cosmetic Fusion Tablet and have the same function as these new tablets!
[*]Existing Rune Maintain Slates have automatically been updated to the new Rune Fusion Charm and have the same function as these new charms!
[*]Two of any normal costume item can now be used in fusion. No more waiting to use two back accessories to fuse a new one!
[/list] 

[b]New Fusion Window[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZxDXw0u.png[/img]

Right click the Cosmetic Fusion Tablet to gain access to the Fusion Tablet window.

[b]New Tablet[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KBtYir0.jpg[/img]
[b]Cosmetic Fusion Tablet:[/b] Use this tablet to fuse two cosmetic items together for a chance at more runeholes or a random costume! Use special charms to influence fusion for a special result!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] Right click this tablet to open the Fusion Tablet window. This tablet is required for every fusion attempt and is consumed upon fusing the items.

 
[b]New Charms[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/x2tFuAB.jpg[/img]
[b]Appearance Fusion Charm:[/b] Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to retain the appearance of the selected costume!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] Allows you to retain the costume type, but does not transfer over things like color dyes. For example, use this charm to make sure your Octopus Head stays an Octopus Head after fusion. When you use the charm, both costume items will have a blue glow around them:
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bfVCupU.png[/img]
 
Once you've selected a costume to retain the appearance of, it will glow with a new border:
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KSroJ5Z.png[/img]
 
You can select either costume item to retain the appearance of. This charm can be used with Rune Fusion Charm. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/IBQDTrU.jpg[/img]
[b]Rune Fusion Charm:[/b] Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to retain your runes and have a chance at more runeholes!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to preserve your existing runes and runeholes in one costume item. When used with an Appearance Fusion Charm, the runes that will be preserved will be the same as the costume that you select to preserve the appearance of. Existing runes will be transferred over. You do not need to have runeholes punched or filled in the costume to have the runeholes transfer. This charm provides a BONUS chance to receive additional runeholes. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DnngLMt.jpg[/img]
[b]Magic Fusion Charm: [/b]Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to have a chance to get a Cheny cosmetic item! This charm is only available through the Cheny Shop. 
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to use two normal costume items to have a chance at a Cheny item. Cheny cosmetic items, such as Kafra Ruby or Swag, cannot be used in normal fusion. This charm increases the chance that you will receive one of these magic costume items in fusion. This charm cannot be combined with other charms. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/X8Jebz0.jpg[/img]
[b]Head Fusion Charm: [/b] Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a head slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new head slot item. The head slot items are the upper head, or hat, slot. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cFCDFbS.jpg[/img]
[b]Lower Face Fusion Charm: [/b]Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a lower face slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new lower face slot item. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/F51lh2W.jpg[/img]
[b]Face Fusion Charm:[/b]  Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a face slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new (middle) face slot item. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fCNLUHa.jpg[/img]
[b]Top Fusion Charm:[/b]  Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a face slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new top slot item. The top slot is the chest or body costume item. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/f4U3WWD.jpg[/img]
[b]Back Fusion Charm:[/b]  Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a back slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b]This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new back slot item.  This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume.

[b]Charm Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Every charm but the Magic Fusion Charm is available in the Kafra Shop. 
[*]Rune Fusion Charms can be combined with all other fusion charms aside from the Magic Fusion Charm.
[*]Appearance Fusion Charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm, but cannot be combined with other types of charms for obvious reasons.
[*]Rune Fusion Charm boosts runehole acquisition chances.
[*]Magic Fusion Charm boosts magic (Cheny) costume item chances. 
[/list] 

[b]Fusion in Action[/b]
Watch the fusion system video guide to see the new items in action!
http://www.youtube.com/embed/zQ7IBPHIU-M

[h1]PVP Attack and Defense Formula Update[/h1]
We've adjusted how the PvP Attack and Reduction is caculated in order to help balance PvP and reduce the stat creep in the game. Previously, you would get a flat, linear increase to your PvP Attack and Reduction with each new rune and hone you were able to put onto your gear. This worked out well at level 50 when there was only so many PvP runeholes. Since the introduction of honing and purple runeholes, this availability increased by a lot without any change to the PvP stat. We are introducing a new way of calculating the stat that will give it diminishing returns if its stacked too high.

Here is how the new stat system should work:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PNdBHfE.png[/img]

This should allow you to get more PvP stats in the beginning, but you will reach a point where adding more will not be as effective anymore. You can still choose to stack it if PvP is your thing, you just won't be able to get at or above 100%.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PsJYNO3.png[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/600_yuleFestival.jpg[/img]
[i]Event Period: December 5, 2016 - January 16, 2017[/i]
	
It's the perfect time to say a hearty, "Ho Ho Ho!"

Some old and new Holiday celebrants are coming to help all the adventurers celebrate their holidays.  Gift giving, decorations, and festivities will be the order of the day this Holiday Season in Ragnarok 2! 

To start the holiday quests, be sure to look for NPC Dasher in Prontera on December 5th! 
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/12/pront.jpg[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/12/dasher.jpg[/img]

To start the Yule Festival Quests, look for Dasher in Prontera! You have to be level 15 before you can start the quest. 

Complete the quest and earn Lutie Snowflakes! 
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/12/reindeernames.jpg[/img]
	
Exchange the Lutie Snowflakes at the Stray Fairy for holiday themed costumes and consumables!

Additionally, if you are level 50, there are two new Yule Festival dailies that can be completed. Finish the quests from Rudolf (in Prontera) and Santa Claus (in a cave behind Donner and Blitzen), and automatically receive a brand new holiday themed Khara Title with the following stat increases.

[b]Santa's Wrapping Paper has been stolen![/b]
In order to celebrate the Yule Festival, Santa Claus is busy preparing gift boxes for children.

Unfortunately, after a sudden surprise attack from monsters, all of Santa's gifts lost their wrapping paper!

In order to assist Santa, help him get rid of the monsters that attacked him and take back the stolen Wrapping Papers.

You can donate Wrapping Paper, or exchange with certain items from Santa Claus in Prontera (next to Myunel).

If donated Wrapping Papers reach a certain amount, Santa will start to sell Upgraded Buff Items!

Santa's Exchange List:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eZHaY67.png[/img]

Use a Santa Poring Warp Scroll to enter the new event dungeon! The scroll has a 6 hour cooldown once used.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EcV1R3O.png[/img]

Items from Santa Claus's vendor list:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Fxz4NHC.png[/img]

Get a Santa Poring's Gift Box for a chance to drop one of these items:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2EoHO5V.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4eGq8pg.jpg?1[/img]
[i]Event Period: December 5, 2016 - December 12, 2016[/i]

Happy Hour Boxes drop four times a day:

02:00-03:00
08:00-09:00
14:00-15:00
20:00-21:00
 
Players have a chance to get an additional box drop during this time by farming monsters within a five level range of the player that will randomly pop out a useful item.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Ea0LMEc.png[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/kafrashop.png[/img]
[h1]New Fusion Items![/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/6StIXjl.png[/img]

[h1]Our Yule Festival Boxes are here![/h1]
[i]Shop Period: December 5, 2016 - January 16, 2017[/i]
Celebrate the Yule Festival this year with these themed costumes, accessories, mounts, and title box!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/yprqe1J.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vpriO4F.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QzSCKdn.png[/img]

And if you're having trouble getting all of your Lutie items for the unique Yule Festival titles, you can always supplement your daily quests and drops by purchasing a Yule Festival Box!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wHk024W.png[/img]

[h1]Our December Munil Boxes are also here![/h1]
[i]Shop Period: December 5 - December 28, 2016[/i]

Looking for cosmetic fodder for our new fusion system? Look no further! You can also wear these costumes and accessories on your character, if you're into that sort of thing.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/w3rAaGr.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/edDMFqP.png[/img]

[h1]December's Lucky Box is in the shop![/h1]
[i]Shop Period: December 5 - December 28, 2016[/i]
Battle the RNG gods and have a chance at one of these December Lucky Box items!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wxoJlg5.png[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Speedhack Detection is being added to and allows us to detect more thoroughly if users are violating the game laws of speed and time
[*]Damage-over-time debuffs will be removed from players once they exit the following maps: Prontera Battlefield, Morroc Fortress, Colosseum, PvP Arena, and Jehoon's Training Site
[*]Flying Robberbug has been added to Culvert N and H
[*]Sand Mane Leader re-spawn time was very inconsistent, so we changed it to re-spawn properly
[*]Wonderland difficulty blocks were inconsistent. Entry for all difficulties have been changed to level 50.
[*]PvP Damage Increase/Decrease stats have been modified. New formual is (PVP)/(PVP+.55). PVP will display this new change in character UI.
[*]Savage and Tame Kelberop Mount Box items and descriptions have been updated for Thai, Japanese, and Taiwan versions of the game
[*]Zombie Mask not working with Appearance Maintain Slte and a bug with 3 runehole head accessories having random fusion issues have been resolved with the new fusion system
[/list]

[*]Existing Rune Maintain Slates have automatically been updated to the new Rune Fusion Charm and have the same function as these new charms!
[*]Two of any normal costume item can now be used in fusion. No more waiting to use two back accessories to fuse a new one!
[/list] 

[b]New Fusion Window[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZxDXw0u.png[/img]

Right click the Cosmetic Fusion Tablet to gain access to the Fusion Tablet window.

[b]New Tablet[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KBtYir0.jpg[/img]
[b]Cosmetic Fusion Tablet:[/b] Use this tablet to fuse two cosmetic items together for a chance at more runeholes or a random costume! Use special charms to influence fusion for a special result!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] Right click this tablet to open the Fusion Tablet window. This tablet is required for every fusion attempt and is consumed upon fusing the items.

 
[b]New Charms[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/x2tFuAB.jpg[/img]
[b]Appearance Fusion Charm:[/b] Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to retain the appearance of the selected costume!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] Allows you to retain the costume type, but does not transfer over things like color dyes. For example, use this charm to make sure your Octopus Head stays an Octopus Head after fusion. When you use the charm, both costume items will have a blue glow around them:
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bfVCupU.png[/img]
 
Once you've selected a costume to retain the appearance of, it will glow with a new border:
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KSroJ5Z.png[/img]
 
You can select either costume item to retain the appearance of. This charm can be used with Rune Fusion Charm. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/IBQDTrU.jpg[/img]
[b]Rune Fusion Charm:[/b] Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to retain your runes and have a chance at more runeholes!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to preserve your existing runes and runeholes in one costume item. When used with an Appearance Fusion Charm, the runes that will be preserved will be the same as the costume that you select to preserve the appearance of. Existing runes will be transferred over. You do not need to have runeholes punched or filled in the costume to have the runeholes transfer. This charm provides a BONUS chance to receive additional runeholes. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DnngLMt.jpg[/img]
[b]Magic Fusion Charm: [/b]Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to have a chance to get a Cheny cosmetic item! This charm is only available through the Cheny Shop. 
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to use two normal costume items to have a chance at a Cheny item. Cheny cosmetic items, such as Kafra Ruby or Swag, cannot be used in normal fusion. This charm increases the chance that you will receive one of these magic costume items in fusion. This charm cannot be combined with other charms. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/X8Jebz0.jpg[/img]
[b]Head Fusion Charm: [/b] Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a head slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new head slot item. The head slot items are the upper head, or hat, slot. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cFCDFbS.jpg[/img]
[b]Lower Face Fusion Charm: [/b]Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a lower face slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new lower face slot item. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/F51lh2W.jpg[/img]
[b]Face Fusion Charm:[/b]  Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a face slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new (middle) face slot item. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fCNLUHa.jpg[/img]
[b]Top Fusion Charm:[/b]  Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a face slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b] This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new top slot item. The top slot is the chest or body costume item. This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/f4U3WWD.jpg[/img]
[b]Back Fusion Charm:[/b]  Use this charm with a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet in order to receive a back slot item!
 
[b]What it Does:[/b]This charm allows you to combine any two normal cosmetic items in order to create a new back slot item.  This charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm to increase your chance at receiving runeholes or to transfer existing runes/runeholes to a new type of costume.

[b]Charm Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Every charm but the Magic Fusion Charm is available in the Kafra Shop. 
[*]Rune Fusion Charms can be combined with all other fusion charms aside from the Magic Fusion Charm.
[*]Appearance Fusion Charm can be combined with Rune Fusion Charm, but cannot be combined with other types of charms for obvious reasons.
[*]Rune Fusion Charm boosts runehole acquisition chances.
[*]Magic Fusion Charm boosts magic (Cheny) costume item chances. 
[/list] 

[b]Fusion in Action[/b]
Watch the fusion system video guide to see the new items in action!
http://www.youtube.com/embed/zQ7IBPHIU-M

[h1]PVP Attack and Defense Formula Update[/h1]
We've adjusted how the PvP Attack and Reduction is caculated in order to help balance PvP and reduce the stat creep in the game. Previously, you would get a flat, linear increase to your PvP Attack and Reduction with each new rune and hone you were able to put onto your gear. This worked out well at level 50 when there was only so many PvP runeholes. Since the introduction of honing and purple runeholes, this availability increased by a lot without any change to the PvP stat. We are introducing a new way of calculating the stat that will give it diminishing returns if its stacked too high.

Here is how the new stat system should work:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PNdBHfE.png[/img]

This should allow you to get more PvP stats in the beginning, but you will reach a point where adding more will not be as effective anymore. You can still choose to stack it if PvP is your thing, you just won't be able to get at or above 100%.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PsJYNO3.png[/img]
