notes.title: [Guide] Episode 3: Reidin Kerse
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YWyV6mK.jpg[/img]
[h1]Episode 3: Reidin Kerse[/h1]
[b]Solo Dungeon[/b]

Morph into your favorite hunter and battle your way through the Hell of Deadly Poison! Use Kerse's skill with a gun to defeat familiar foes and earn new prizes!

[h1]Daily Quests[/h1]
Visit Maden in Bouquet Town before you enter the dungeon. She has daily quests for all solo dungeons. The new quest, Cave of Queen Ant, requires you defeat Maya and rewards you with 84 diamonds. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1RU8gd9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enter the Dungeon[/h1]
You can enter the dungeon by pressing "N" and clicking the "Find Dungeon" tab. Check the box for Episode 3: Reidin Kerse and begin the dungeon by pressing the bottom "Find Dungeon" button. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FF45MSG.png[/img]

[h1]Fighting as Reidin Kerse[/h1]
You will fight in the dungeon as Reidin Kerse. He has a set of main skills, as well as clickable on-screen health potions, reload skill, and AoE damage skill. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/qW6Lpn8.png[/img]

[h1]Main Skills[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/spWBKag.png[/img]
[b]#1 Single Shot:[/b] Instant Cast, No Cooldown, 20m Range
Gives damage to a single target. Consumes 1 bullet. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xwITDte.png[/img]
[b]#2 Explosion:[/b] Instant Cast, 5 Second Cooldown, 20m Range
Gives damage to up to 5 targets and decreases their movement speed. Consumes 3 bullets.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VnPDD0w.png[/img]
[b]#3 Backward Roll:[/b] Instant Cast, 5 Second Cooldown
Roll backward 12m.

[h1]Secondary Skills[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TB04YWf.png[/img]
[b]Reload:[/b] 1.5 Second Cast, No Cooldown.
Reload 10 bullets. Can be applied twice, up to 20 bullets. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HUje6G5.png[/img]
[b]Gun Fire:[/b]  Instant Cast, 10 Second Cooldown
Damage up to 20 hostile targets within 17m of the target. Consume 5 bullets.

[h1]Recovery Skills[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/aVQoAju.png[/img]
[b]Potion Drink (L):[/b] Recover full HP. Instant Cast, 60 Second Cooldown.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qPWFgzF.png[/img]
[b]Potion Drink (S):[/b] Recover 2200 HP per second over 10 seconds.

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
Level 10-25: 1 Loki's Cube
Level 16-40: 2 Loki's Cube
Master Level: 3 Loki's Cube


[h1]Helpful Tips[/h1]
[list]
[*]When you enter the dungeon, all buffs will be removed except for Elite Membership, Norn's Blessing, and Midgard's Grace. The dungeon is auto-balanced for difficulty.
[*]The explosion skill places a DoT on the targets and slows them. Use your Backward Roll skill to keep your distance! You don't have to face your enemy to use explosion or single shot.
[*]Remember to Reload!
[/list]

[b]Please Note:[/b] Diamonds can also be earned in-game through quests and events. [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/189631-guide-chenys-secret-shop/]Please visit the Cheny's Secret Shop guide for more information.[/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9Vt85y2.png[/img]
[url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/189633-guide-winter-2015-update/]A complete guide to the Winter 2015 Update's features can be found here.[/url]
[h1]Mysterious NPC Cheny[/h1]
The mysterious Cheny is a descendant of Khara. Some time ago, she decided to follow Khara's steps through Midgard. In her travels she met the Dvergr-- an ancient race of ground-dwelling dwarves. Cheny offered her help to the Dvergr, and in return she received a special pet Leprechaun.

Cheny has returned to Prontera with her new friend, Leprechaun, and the two are working together to collect Diamonds for her next journey.

Cheny's Secret Shop contains a collection of items that she has curated throughout her travels. These items will change from time to time. Leprechaun is using his magic to help Cheny collect diamonds. Visit the Leprechaun to learn more about Transmogrification!

Cheny and Leprechaun are located in SW Prontera, in the Graham Arena:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5uFfwgs.jpg[/img]

[url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/189631-guide-chenys-secret-shop/]Please visit the Official Guide to Cheny's Secret Shop for more information![/url]

[h1]Transmogrification[/h1]
Armor and certain weapons can now change their appearance through Transmogrification! This new item allows you to keep the stats of your base item, but exchange its image with another item of the same type.

Target item will retain its stats, refinement, sockets, and honing. The appearance item will be consumed in the process.

Items must share the same type to be transmogrified (Example: Cloth chest armor to cloth chest armor).

Transmogrification requires Diamonds and Zeny as payment. Transmogrification is performed by Leprechaun, located near Cheny in the Graham Arena of Prontera. 

[url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/189528-guide-transmogrification/]Please visit the Transmogrification Official Guide for more information![/url]

[h1]Transmogrification Items[/h1]
Four new sets of Transmogrification items have been added for Human characters, and one new set has been added for Noel characters. These Transmogrification items have four individual pieces each so sets can be mixed, matched, or used with other armor appearances to make your outfit unique! These items are obtainable from Cheny's Snowflake boxes.

[b]Furious Goblin (M) and Convicted Goblin (F)[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/664Y5kn.gif[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/WUxmMpr.gif[/img]

[b]Oriental Night (M) and Oriental Morning (F)[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/t8I8Kyo.gif[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/w1lIamB.gif[/img]

[b]Purified Flame (M) and Judged Flame (F)[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Le0Xcj2.gif[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/cA2MWmg.gif[/img]

[b]Tropic Protector (M) and Tropic Destroyer (F)[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HhCGwNg.gif[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/GupuVZY.gif[/img]

[b]Noel Set: Star Clown (M) and Moon Clown (F)[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pna5klF.gif[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/IpyYltA.gif[/img]

[h1]Multi-Dye System[/h1]
The existing Dye system has gotten a makeover! New costumes can take different dyes in up to three different areas. [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/189654-guide-multi-dye-system/?p=2349424]Please visit the Multi-Dye System guide for more information![/url]

Preview:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/05L6CVE.gif[/img]

[h1]2nd Episode Dungeon[/h1]
Join a young Dr. Jacob as he learns the secret of the Wolves Cave! Daily quests associated with solo dungeons can be found at Maden in Bouquet Town, East Mt. Mjolnir. The dungeon can be accessed by pressing "N" to reach the Find Dungeon menu. Check the box for Ep. 2 Hidden Report and off you go!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1RU8gd9.jpg[/img]

[url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/189652-guide-episode-2-wolves-cave/]Visit the Episode 2: Wolves Cave Guide for more information![/url]

[h1]Attendance Calendar Update[/h1]
The daily attendance calendar has updated! You can now receive Diamonds on Day 7, Day 14, and Day 21. If you log in without missing days, you'll receive double the Diamonds on golden-marked days!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/fy2e4rd.gif[/img]

Please Note there has been a chance:
(7 day) will be a Seal of Vulcan
(14 day) will be a Seal of Veriel
(21 day) will be a Seal of Hoenheim
(28 day) will be a Seal of Demeter

Perfect Attendance Reward will be changing as well: 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vJDn0N8.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome Santa and the Yule Festival![/h1]
[i]Event Period: December 15 - January 18[/i]
In order to celebrate the Yule Festival, Santa Claus is busy preparing gift boxes for children.

Unfortunately, after a sudden surprise attack from monsters, all of Santa's gifts lost their wrapping paper!

In order to assist Santa, help him get rid of the monsters that attacked him and take back the stolen Wrapping Papers.

You can donate Wrapping Paper, or exchange with certain items from Santa Claus in Prontera (next to Myunel).

If donated Wrapping Papers reach a certain amount, Santa will start to sell Upgraded Buff Items!

Santa's Exchange List:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eZHaY67.png[/img]

Use a Santa Poring Warp Scroll to enter the new event dungeon! The scroll has a 6 hour cooldown once used.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EcV1R3O.png[/img]

Items from Santa Claus's vendor list:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Fxz4NHC.png[/img]

Get a Santa Poring's Gift Box for a chance to drop one of these items:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2EoHO5V.png[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Heal over time skills will no longer display as damage over time in any circumstance 
[*]War of Emperium's Immunity buff will now be immune to damage, area of effect damage, crowd control, and stun. Players with an active immunity buff will not be able to use food, potions, or item buffs. If a player uses a skill or moves while having the buff, it will be removed. Players entering the WoE map with Urgent Recall will receive the Immunity Buff.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: October 26, 2015
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes October 26, 2015
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: Monday 3pm- 10pm PST (~7 hours)[/h1]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Changes.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/Servermerge.jpg[/img]
Worlds will collide on October 26th! 
[b]FAQs
1. What is going to happen?[/b]
On October 26th, 2015 during maintenance, Freya will be merging into Odin.   

[b]2. What about the economies for both servers?[/b]
We are using a 1:50 exchange ratio for zeny for Freyja players merging into Odin. This means that a Freyja character will retain 2% of their zeny after the merge. This also applies to guild zeny.

This is based on monitoring both economies. We want to blend the two economies without causing the inflation in Freyja to cause economic damage to Odin’s market.

Resell value of NPC vendor items will be reduced from 10% to 1% permanently. This is to avoid reselling items to get past the exchange rate.

[b]3. What about guild housing?[/b]
Guild Housing will be doubled from 16 Houses to 32 Houses, and Freyja Guilds that hold houses at the time of the merge will keep their house on Odin after the merge.

[b]4. What will happen to the War of Emperium Castle and Fortress ownership?[/b]
Ownership will be reset on Odin during the October 26th merge.

[b]5. What about the auction house?[/b] 
Freyja's auction house will be closed on October 14th, in preparation for the merge. 

[b]6. What about my mail?[/b]
Freyja's mail will not be transferred, so make sure you pull all your valuables out of your mailbox prior to the October 26 maintenance!

[b]7. What about my character slots?[/b]
Players can have up to 20 character slots taken after the merge, depending on how many total characters they had during the merge.

For example, if a player has 10 Odin characters and 10 Freyja characters, they will keep 20 after the merge. Players will not be able to make more than 10 characters, and if they delete any characters they will not be able to make another character to regain that slot.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[h1]Halloween Clowns are invading![/h1]
[i]Event Period: October 26 - November 16, 2015[/i]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Sfy7dmQ.jpg?1[/img]
During Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, [b]Party Crashers[/b] (Level 50) will be invading different zones of Midgard from 09:00-09:30 and 17:00-17:30! Make sure you're in game at the start to know which zones are being invaded!

[b]Party Crashers[/b] will have a chance to drop a [b]Swag Box[/b]!

[b]Swag Boxes[/b] have a chance to drop one of the following:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Y7u4500.png?1[/img]

[h1]PowerUp Boxes! Get your PowerUp Boxes here![/h1]
[i]Event Period: October 26 - November 23, 2015[/i]
Players that accumulate 10 or more hours per week will be rewarded with a PowerUp Box during the following maintenance.

PowerUp Box has a chance to drop one of the following:
[list]
[*]Adventurer's Battle Manual Order
[*]Pandora's Key
[*]Prontera Warp Scroll
[*]Spinel Purple Potion
[*]The Chance Coupon
[*]Thief Potion
[/list]

[h1][url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/186784-community-event-light-in-the-dark-pumpkin-carving-lantern-contest/]Light in the Dark[/url][/h1]
[i]Event Period: October 16 through November 6[/i]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/rieGaBP.jpg[/img]
As the light of summer fades, the nights grow longer... darker... more frightening. October is the month we celebrate Halloween, and though customs vary from culture to culture, many celebrate this night by creating a lantern-- a light in the dark. Put your artistic and creative skills to work in this event! Carve a pumpkin or create a lantern to help illuminate the darkness and ward off wandering spirits this Halloween night. 

[b]Entries[/b]
Entries will be accepted from October 16 through November 6.

[b]There are two categories for your entry:
Carved Pumpkin[/b] - Carve a pumpkin, a different gourd, or even a turnip. Use your imagination to carve a real (or plastic) illuminated Jack-o-Lantern with an RO2 theme. Example

[b]Lantern[/b] - A jar covered in paper, a paper bag, or a milk jug. You can make a lantern out of almost anything! Create a RO2 themed lantern from whatever you have handy. Example

[b]Prizes[/b]
One [b]People's Choice[/b] winner per category will be selected. These will each receive one permanent Phantom Racer mount!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WvEEDJL.gif[/img]

One [b]Staff Favorite[/b] winner will be selected per category. Winners will receive [Pumpkin Cloak] and [Pumpkin Mask] costume items (1 slot). 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/C9ueqNU.gif[/img]
Every quality entry will also receive a 7-Day VIP.

[h1][url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/186026-halloween-screenshot-contest/]Halloween Screenshot Contest![/url][/h1]
[i]Event Period: October 1 - October 30, 2015[/i]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/screenshot_contest.png[/img]
Good evenings Goblins and Ghouls,

Time to get that photographer in you out once again.   Through the month of October we are running a Halloween Screenshot Contest!  

Don your favorite costume or find the scariest location in Ragnarok Online 2 and share the experience through screenshots!

[b]Rewards:[/b]

All participants will receive 3 Phantom Stones. 

However, at the end of the month we will be putting all the entries up to a vote and the top five will also receive: 
[list]
[*](1) Mount Box
[*](1) Random Dye
[*](5) Phantom stones instead of the 3
[*](1) Super Large Bag
[/list]

[h1]Pirate Event is ending![/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hl1T5i8.jpg[/img]
The Pirate event will end on November 2, 2015!

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/kafrashop.png[/img]
[h1]Celebrate Halloween with the Phantom Racer mount![/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WvEEDJL.gif[/img]
[b]Premium Mount Box (Phantom Racer)
Price: 100 Kafra Points[/b]
This box has a chance to drop one of the following:
[list]
[*]Phantom Racer (Permanent)
[*]Phantom Racer (14 days)
[*]Black Tiger Reins (14 days)
[*]Tiger Reins (14 days)
[*]White Tiger Reins (14 days)
[*]Nippy Peco Peco Rein (14 days)
[*]Noble Peco Reins (14 days)
[/list]

[b]Phantom Racer Reins (30 days)
Price: 400 Kafra Points[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/o1hmocX.png[/img]
[h1]Honing Sale for one week![/h1]
[i]Sale Period: October 26 - November 2, 2015[/i]
We will be listed these Honing Items 30% off for one week:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HEDISUq.png[/img]

[h1]October Lucky Box is on sale for one week![/h1]
[i]Sale Period: October 26 - November 2, 2015[/i]
[b]October Lucky Box
SALE Price: 210 Kafra Points[/b]
October's Lucky Box has a chance of dropping one of the following items:
[list]
[*]5 Chance Coupons
[*]5 Divine Protections
[*]5 Master Battle Manual Orders
[*]5 Phantom Stones
[*]Phantom Racer (30 days)
[*]Argos Rein
[*]Argos Rein (30 Days)
[*]Halloween Costume (Man)
[*]Halloween Costume (Woman)
[*]Halloween Hat
[*]Jack's Mask
[*]Killer's Knife
[*]Pumpkin Mask
[*]Devil Costume
[*]Pumpkin Cloak
[*]Devil Wings
[*]Jack the Ripper
[*]Kirkena
[*]RO1 Crusader Style (Man)
[*]RO1 Crusader Style (Woman)
[*]White Designated Dye
[/list]
Use the White Designated Dye to guarantee a white color for your costume or accessory!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eCP68Sa.jpg?1[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
[list]
[*]+3 and +4 Wisdom Runes have been renamed to Glowing Wisdom Rune and Bright Wisdom Rune
[*]Ymir Child Cthulhu will show an increase to Penetration by 450, not 450%.
[/list]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes October 19, 2015
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: Monday 6pm- 10pm PST (~4 hours)[/h1]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[h1]Halloween Event: Something Wicked this way comes![/h1]
[i]Event Duration: October 19 - November 16, 2015[/i]
Midgardians are called to investigate old ruins to help save a village and discover the ultimate secret to a ruined castle!
Those that are level 15 or higher can find Astrior Collins in Prontera to start their adventure:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vcwSfPN.jpg?1[/img]
This year's Halloween event brings the following to Ragnarok 2:
[list]
[*]14 new quests
[*]3 Daily Quests after you complete the main storyline.

[b]Helga the Herbalist[/b] in [b]Izlude[/b] gives [b][Daily Event] The Soul Collector[/b] and rewards an [b]Adventurer's Battle Manual Order[/b]!

[b]King Thorolf[/b] in [b]Izlude[/b] gives [b][Daily Event] Silly monsters, tricks are for the living[/b] and adventurers can choose from 3 [b]Seals of Vulcan, Veriel, Hoenheim, or Demeter[/b]

[b]Astrior Collins[/b] in [b]Prontera[/b] gives [b][Daily Event] Who's Afraid of the Big Bad Wolf[/b] and adventurers can choose from 3 [b]Seals of Vulcan, Veriel, Hoenheim, or Demeter[/b]

[*]A new Khara title, [b]Draugr Slayer[/b], that you can earn by completing the main storyline!
[b]Draugr Slayer[/b] will be a suffix title and gives the following effects:
[i]+28 STR, +27 INT, +28 AGI, +12 WIS, and +42 VIT[/i]
[*]A new Halloween Costume Box and Halloween Accessory Box that drop one-slot cosmetic items from the Kafra Shop!
[*]Creepy Clown invasions that drop Swag Boxes! (Coming October 26)

notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes October 19, 2015
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: Monday 6pm- 10pm PST (~4 hours)[/h1]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[h1]Halloween Event: Something Wicked this way comes![/h1]
[i]Event Duration: October 19 - November 16, 2015[/i]
Midgardians are called to investigate old ruins to help save a village and discover the ultimate secret to a ruined castle!
Those that are level 15 or higher can find Astrior Collins in Prontera to start their adventure:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vcwSfPN.jpg?1[/img]
This year's Halloween event brings the following to Ragnarok 2:
[list]
[*]14 new quests
[*]3 Daily Quests after you complete the main storyline.

[b]Helga the Herbalist[/b] in [b]Izlude[/b] gives [b][Daily Event] The Soul Collector[/b] and rewards an [b]Adventurer's Battle Manual Order[/b]!

[b]King Thorolf[/b] in [b]Izlude[/b] gives [b][Daily Event] Silly monsters, tricks are for the living[/b] and adventurers can choose from 3 [b]Seals of Vulcan, Veriel, Hoenheim, or Demeter[/b]

[b]Astrior Collins[/b] in [b]Prontera[/b] gives [b][Daily Event] Who's Afraid of the Big Bad Wolf[/b] and adventurers can choose from 3 [b]Seals of Vulcan, Veriel, Hoenheim, or Demeter[/b]

[*]A new Khara title, [b]Draugr Slayer[/b], that you can earn by completing the main storyline!
[b]Draugr Slayer[/b] will be a suffix title and gives the following effects:
[i]+28 STR, +27 INT, +28 AGI, +12 WIS, and +42 VIT[/i]
[*]A new Halloween Costume Box and Halloween Accessory Box that drop one-slot cosmetic items from the Kafra Shop!
[*]Creepy Clown invasions that drop Swag Boxes! (Coming October 26)

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/kafrashop.png[/img]
[h1]Spooktacular Halloween Costume and Accessory Boxes![/h1]
[i]Sale Duration: October 19 - November 16, 2015[/i]
[b]Halloween Costume Box
Price: 300 Kafra Points[/b]
Open this spooktacular Halloween Costume Box, if you dare, for a random chance to receive a 1 slot version of the following:
[list]
[*]Devil Costume (Male)
[*]Devil Costume (Female)
[*]Amusement Park Costume (Male)
[*]Amusement Park Costume (Female)
[*]Horse Costume (Female)
[*]Horse Costume (Male)
[*]Osiris Costume (Male)
[*]Osiris Costume (Female)
[*]Angel Costume (Male)
[*]Angel Costume (Female)
[*]Halloween Costume (Man)
[*]Halloween Costume (Woman)
[*]Jack The Ripper
[*]Kirkena
[/list]

[b]Halloween Accessory Box
Price: 200 Kafra Points[/b]
Open this spooktacular Halloween Accessory Box, if you dare, for a random chance to receive a 1 slot version of the following:
[list]
[*]Baby Devil's Horn
[*]Bandage
[*]Black Cat's Ears
[*]Corrupted Mask
[*]Devil Horn
[*]Egg Ghost
[*]Halloween Hat
[*]Horse Mask (Female)
[*]Horse Mask (Male)
[*]Phantom of the Opera Mask
[*]Jack the Ripper Hat
[*]Kirkena Hat
[*]Pumpkin Mask
[*]Pumpkin Cloak
[*]Bone Dragon's Wing
[*]Devil Wings
[*]Angel Ring
[*]Angel Wing
[*]Osiris Crown (Male)
[*]Osiris Crown (Female)
[*]Osiris Cape (Male)
[*]Osiris Cape (Female)
[/list]

[h1]New VIP Packs for October![/h1]
[b]October Platinum Membership Pack 
Price: 2000 Kafra Points[/b]
This Pack will give you the following:
[list]
[*](1) Elite Membership Card (30 days/Poring)
[*](1) Mount Period Extension (30 days)
[*](1) Refine Transfer Ticket
[*](1) Card Album (30 days)
[*](1) Adventure's Pack
[*](3) Thief Potions
[*](5) Holgren's Honing Polish Box
[*](5) Complete Honing Scrubs
[*](10) Special Honing Oil (10%)
[*](10) Explorer Pack

[b]October Gold Membership Pack 
Price: 900 Kafra Points[/b]
This Pack will give you the following:
[list]
[*](1) Elite Membership Card (30 days)/Poring)
[*](1) Card Album (30 days)
[*](10) Pump it Up Pills
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/o1hmocX.png[/img]
[h1]Refinement Sale for One Week![/h1]
[i]Sale Period: October 19 - October 26, 2015[/i]
We are listing our refinement items 30% off for one week!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UnkAGLL.png?1[/img]

[h1]September's Alpaca Mount on Sale for One Week![/h1]
[i]Sale Period: October 19 - October 26, 2015[/i]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EgNUtUJ.gif?1[/img]
[b]Premium Mount Box (Alpaca)
SALE Price: 70 Kafra Points[/b]
This box has a chance to drop one of the following:
[list]
[*]Alpaca (Permanent)
[*]Alpaca (14 days)
[*]Black Tiger Reins (14 days)
[*]Tiger Reins (14 days)
[*]White Tiger Reins (14 days)
[*]Nippy Peco Peco Rein (14 days)
[*]Noble Peco Reins (14 days)
[/list]

[b]Alpaca Reins (30 days)
SALE Price: 280 Kafra Points[/b]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Visual and dye issues with the Zombie Mask and Costume should be resolved now
[*]Arista should be described as female and not male
[*]Various naming inconsistencies in the War of Emperium map have been fixed
[/list]

[h1]Costume Fusion Sale for One Week![/h1]
[i]Sale Period: October 14 - October 18, 2015[/i]
[b]Accessory Fusion Tablet
SALE Price: 100 Kafra Points[/b]
Use an Accessory Fusion Tablet to fuse two accessories together for a new accessory and possibly more runeholes!

[b]Costume Fusion Tablet
SALE Price: 100 Kafra Points[/b]
Use a Costume Fusion Tablet to fuse two costumes together for a new costume and possibly more runeholes!

[b]Appearance Maintain Slate
SALE Price: 150 Kafra Points[/b]
Use an Appearance Maintain Slate during Costume or Accessory Fusion to keep the appearance of one of the costumesor accessories!

[b]Rune Maintain Slate
SALE Price: 150 Kafra Points[/b]
Use a Rune Maintain Slate during Costume or Accessory Fusion to keep the runes slotted into runeholes of one of the costumes or accessories!

[h1]VIP Sale for One Week![/h1]
[i]Sale Period: October 14 - October 18, 2015[/i]
[b]September Platinum Membership Pack
SALE Price: 1400 Kafra Points[/b]
The Platinum Membership Pack contains the following:
[list]
[*](1) Elite Membership Card (30 Days/Poring)
[*](1) Card Album

[*](10) Special Honing Oil (10%)
[*](5) Complete Honing Scrub
[*](5) Holgren's Honing Polish Box
[*](1) Refine Transfer Ticket
[*](1) Adventure's Pack
[*](10) Explorer Pack
[*](3) Thief Potion
[/list]

[b]September Gold Membership Pack
SALE Price: 630 Kafra Points[/b]
The Gold Membership Pack contains the following:
[list]
[*](1) Elite Membership Card (30 Days/Poring)
[*](1) Card Album
[*](10) Pump It Up Pill
[/list]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/events.png[/img]
[h1]Dapara’s EXP Week[/h1]
[i]Event Period: October 14 - October 18, 2015[/i]
[img]http://fat.gfycat.com/FatherlyWeirdHare.gif[/img]
[b]The EXP Boosts:[/b]
[list]
[*]200% EXP on Weekdays
[*]500% EXP on Weekends (Friday 17:00 - Monday 12:00)
[/list]

[b]Dapara will be in Morroc City selling items for Mastery Points:[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/NIdONLf.png?1[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Morroc Fortress map will properly display when a client is switched to the Portuguese language
[*]Original Happy Hour Box description was incorrectly displaying it also dropped Lucky and Blessing Powder. The description will be changed to remove those items to match item up with original Patch Notes
[*]Kafra Jakiya of Morroc City will no longer pretend she is part of the Long Range Flying Transpotation Service and has had her dialogue adjusted
[*]When killing Ttoki, it will no longer give the message "Spirit of Forest has gone from Ormes" and display the correct message. When killing Arist, it will no longer mention Queen Serenia.
[*]Players in the Normal or Hard Mode versions of the Jawaii Wonderland dungeon will now be displayed accurately in their guild menu instead of always showing up on Easy Mode.
[/list]

[/list]

New quests have been added for adventurers to take on Queen Serenia!
Midgardians will find the following new quests in-game:

[*]Who is angry??
[*]Real owner of Jawaii Island (1)
[*]Real owner of Jawaii Island (2)
[*]Nature conservation, Human protection?
[/list]

The Seal of Jawaii has been weakened!
[list]
[*]The required items for opening the Wonderland raid dungeon has been reduced by 25%
[*]Wonderland will now remain open for 12 hours, up from 6 hours
[*]Adventurers will now find that items for the event will drop more often
[/list]

SALE Price: 280 Kafra Points[/b]

SALE Price: 70 Kafra Points[/b]
This random box has a chance to drop one of the following:

Avast ye mateys!  There be an art contest on the horizon.   

From Sept. 9th to the 16th we will be searching the high seas for some creative Pirate themed art to celebrate our fun Pirate adventures in game!

Five lucky winners will be featured in the Ragnarok Online 2 loading screen, but fear not. Even if you don't win, for just sharing your extraordinary talent we will be giving away 5 phantom stone per player.   

Rules that apply: 
1. Must be pirate themed or high seas themed. 
2. Must be a part of the Ragnark Online 2 Universe.
3. Must be original art by the artist.  Cannot be a screenshot or someone else's art.
 4. Can be in various mediums however the final submission will need to be digital. So if you are doing an acrylic painting please scan it and post.  
6. Formats for the art need to be in either DDS, PSD, or Jpeg.
7. They must also be 1920 x 1080 px.  If they are larger they will get cropped or resized.
8. You may post your submission on the forums or if you are feeling shy you may send them to cmvaritas@gmail.com but make sure that the subject line reads "Pirate Art Contest 2015" and your forum name. 
 
Once the submissions have come in and the contest closes, we will go ahead and create a form so that everyone may vote.  That's it!
 
We hope you have fun and don't be shy.  Scribbles on Parchment work too.
Arrrrrr!

Patch Notes: July 29, 2015

Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.

Weekly Maintenance Time: 6 pm PST (~4 hours)

Welcome, RO2 players from Thailand!

July Lucky Box

Sale 300 KP (One week only!)

July’s Lucky Box has a chance of dropping one of the following items:

5 Chance Coupons

5 Divine Protections

5 Master Battle Manual Orders

5 Phantom Stones

Gongurat Rocket

Gongurat Rocket (30 Days)

Tartan Costume

Tartan Wig

Wings of Fallen Angel

RO1 Bard Style (+6 to primary stats)

RO1 Dancer Style (+6 to primary stats)

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Changes.png[/img]

WarpPortal welcomes Ragnarok 2 players from Thailand!

 

We are excited to have players from Thailand's Ragnarok 2 joining us on our international server, Freyja, later this month. The community of Ragnarok Online 2 continues to grow in exciting ways with the addition of new players!

 

We hope you will quickly create bonds of friendship that span the globe!

 

FAQ:

Q: When will I be able to opt-in to merge my characters from TH RO2 to iRO2?

A: TH RO2 will have an in-game opt-in method on July 7. On July 28, their service will close. On July 30, we will merge TH RO2 players that opted in via the in-game method into iRO2.

 

Q: Will there be a method to opt-in to merge after TH RO2 is closed?

A: Yes! There will be an opt-in website page for TH RO2 players to opt-in after it closes that is expected to run until October 7.

 

Q: What sort of items will not be merged into iRO2 from TH RO2?

A: Players will  be unable to bring over guilds, mail, kafra cash, and auctions.

 

Update:

We will also be restricting any unique items that only existed on TH RO2 and do not exist in Warpportal's RO2.

We will also be restricting how much zeny characters can come over with.

If you have up to 50,000 zeny, you may keep it.

If you have 50,001-170,000 zeny, you will keep 50,000.

If you have above 170,000 zeny, you will keep 30% of your zeny.

 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png[/img]

 

- Dapara's Weekend 500% Weekend EXP was not intended to run outside of Dapara's EXP week. We have detained Dapara for questioning, and the weekend EXP boost should go back to 200%.

notes.title: WarpPortal Downtime & Compensation
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/404.png[/img]
[b]Hello RO2 Players![/b]
 
Early on Wednesday morning, a critical part of our network’s connection to the world failed. This caused all WarpPortal titles, websites, and forum to be inaccessible, as well as cut off our office internet connection. Our tech team and ISP worked to replace the failed part as quickly as possible, but the result was that for several days players on all our titles were unable to play or connect with us.

No data was impacted during this outage, as it was an issue with our internet connection line.  Your characters and data are safe.
 
As our thanks and apologies for bearing with us during the outage, we’ll be sending your inboxes some goodies:
[list]
[*]A 7 Day Elite Membership Card
[*]A 7 Day Card Album
[*]3 Master Battle Manual Orders (24 hours)
[/list]

These items were distributed today to all active players for compensation for the downtime.
 
Additionally, since our Happy Hour Box Week was impacted during this time, we will be running a second [b]Happy Hour Box Week[/b] this month from [b]May 18th to 25th[/b]. This week will follow an EXP boost and Dapara event scheduled for next week’s update on the 6th.
 
We’d like to express our sincerest apologies for the inconveniences this caused, and want to thank you for your passion for playing Ragnarok Online 2, which you’ve expressed through your messages to us via social media during this process.

We are happy to say RO2 is back up and accessible now! Happy playing!

notes.title: Create your own RO2 Adventure!
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/createyourownadventure.jpg[/img]
[b]Create your own RO2 Adventure:[/b]
Dark Whisper Edition!
April 20th - June 1st, 2015
 
Have a creative idea for a quest? Want to be immortalized in game? Now is your time to shine!
20 daily quests will be chosen from player entries to be put into the world of RO2. The top 5 entries will have their creator’s character made into an NPC that will issue out the winning quest lines!
 
[b]How to enter:[/b]
Create a daily quest. This must be a repeatable quest line like the ones found on daily boards around Rune-Midgarts.
Choose how you’d like your NPC to look. Put on your finest outfit and screenshot it! Host this image on a free image service such as photobucket.
Provide the desired location of your NPC. Suggested locations: Morroc or Dark Whisper area.

Entries are now CLOSED. Thank you for your entries!

notes.title: Easter Egg Hunt
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/EasterEggHunt.jpg[/img]

[b]Easter Egg Hunt[/b]
4/13/2015~5/11/2015
 
The egg hunt is on in Rune-Midgarts!  Visit [b]NPC Tokki[/b] and [b]NPC Clinkz[/b] in Prontera Square to start this year’s Easter themed quests.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/CollectEggs.png[/img]
You can collect eggs by completing quests, find them as field drops, and pull them out of the Easter Event Random Box in the Kafra Shop!
Event and Daily Quests are available for the duration of this event.
Monsters within a range that is 5 levels above or below your character will drop event eggs. Monsters that are beyond that range will have a greatly decreased rate of dropping event eggs.
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/ExchangeEggs.png[/img]
Exchange your eggs with [b]NPC Tokki[/b]
Trade [b]10 Unknown Eggs[/b] for [b]1 Pure Egg[/b]
Trade [b]5 Pure Eggs[/b] for [b]1 Blessed Egg[/b]
Trade [b]5 Blessed Eggs[/b] for [b]1 Glittering Egg[/b]
Trade [b]3 Glittering Eggs[/b] for [b]1 Handicraft Egg[/b]
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/EasterEventTitles.png[/img]
Collect [b]10 Handicraft Eggs[/b] to exchange them for the [b]Easter Egg[/b] Title!
Easter Egg Title: [b]STR + 100, AGI + 70, VIT + 50, ACC + 150[/b]
Stats are doubled during the duration of the event)
 
Collect [b]30 Glittering Eggs[/b] to exchange them for the [b]Easter Day Title![/b]
Easter Day Title: [b]INT + 100, AGI + 70, VIT + 50, CAST TIME+ 150[/b]
Stats are doubled during the duration of the event)
 
Eggs can be used as buff items as well!
Pure and Blessed eggs will recover some of your HP/SP for 10 seconds when used as a consumable.
Glittering Eggs will increase STR, INT, AGI, INT, HP by 30 for 10 minutes.
Blessed Eggs will increase Crit Hit, Accuracy, Dodge, VIT, AGI by 45 for 10 minutes!

notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/TweetTreats.png[/img]
[b]Tweet Treats Event[/b]
Are you on twitter? We are and we’re inviting you to join us in the #RO2 conversation!
 
Follow us at https://twitter.com/PlayRagnarok2
 
This event runs from April 2 to April 30. Warm up those tweeting fingers, folks! Whenever you feel like tweeting about RO2- recruiting guildmates, beating the RNG gods, or feeling salty over that last round of colo- don’t forget to use the hashtag #RO2 when you get in game!
 
[b]#RO2[/b] Hastag used [b]200[/b] times in Tweets = [b]1 Storage Slot Expansion[/b]
[b]#RO2[/b] Hastag used [b]300[/b] times in Tweets= [b]1 +5 Weapon Refine Stone[/b]
[b]#RO2[/b] Hastag used [b]400[/b] time in Tweets= [b]10x Thief Potions[/b]
[b]#RO2[/b] Hastag used [b]500[/b] times in Tweets=[b]1  +10 Weapon Refine Stone[/b]
[b]#RO2[/b] Hastag used [b]600[/b] times in Tweets= [b]A  14-day Elite VIP Card[/b]
 
Items will go out to all accounts active during the event period (so make sure you’ve played in April to qualify!)
These achievements [b]stack[/b] so if 600 people use the #RO2 hastag between now and April 30th, everyone who qualifies will receive each reward listed! Items will be distributed after May 4th’s update.
 
[b]But that’s not all![/b] New followers also mean EXP boosts!
[b]500[/b] New Twitter Followers = [b]2x EXP Boost[/b]
[b]1000[/b] New Twitter Followers = [b]3x EXP Boost[/b]
[b]1500[/b] New Twitter Followers = [b]4x EXP Boost[/b]
[b]2000[/b] New Twitter Followers = [b]5x EXP Boost[/b]
[b]2500[/b] New Twitter Followers = [b]6x EXP Boost[/b]
EXP boosts will begin on May 4th and run until June 1st, so tell your guildmates and friends!

notes.title: Language Options
notes.content:
[b]Language Options[/b]
You can now select different language menus in Ragnarok Online 2!

To change your language settings, select the desired language from either the [b]Screen Options[/b] menu or in the [b]Game Settings.[/b]
 
To select another language from the [b]Screen Options[/b] menu, use the drop down feature under [b]Language.[/b]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/changelanguage1.jpg[/img]
 
To change your language after you have loaded up the game, select [b]Game Settings[/b] and toggle the selected language.

[b]*You must restart the client to have this change to take effect.*[/b]

 [img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/changelanguage2.jpg[/img]

More language options will be added over time in future updates to the game.

notes.title: Forgotten Payon Launches!
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/ForPayon.png[/img]


Long forgotten and left to run wild, Payon’s ruins have revealed a new region full of fearsome monsters and challenges for players in Rune-Midgarts! Join your fellow player on an adventure into the remains of Payon and level to new heights!
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/Payon3.png[/img]

Find the Old Well in Payon's Ruins to begin your journey into Forgotten Payon.
 
This new area is teeming with monsters and drops for master level characters to combat! The master level cap has risen to ML 35 with the addition of this new region in the game.
  
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/Payon1.png[/img]
 
New armor sets and weapons are available in this new area for Master Level players!
 
Earn tokens for Eddga gear from monster drops and daily quests. Get lucky with rare drops of Eddga gear off area bosses as well!
 
[img] http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/Payon2.png[/img]

Speak with new NPCs, challenge field monsters, and fight bosses in the 80-85 level range.
 
 
You can now trade for Cazar gear to equip yourself for venturing into Payon! Visit NPC [b]Hansu[/b] in Prontera to trade in Blood points or Victory Metals. Visit NPC [b]Jado[/b] in Morroc to trade in Mastery Points. Buy pieces of gear directly or take your chance with a random box!
 
Runes have been overhauled and now give out fixed number stats rather than stats based on percentages.
 
This new area is tough, so come prepared! Bring your allies and fight to reclaim the ruins of a once beautiful city.
 
 
The fearsome [b]Eddga[/b] awaits you in Forgotten Payon!
[b]Are you prepared?[/b]

notes.title: Eddga the Thief
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/eddgathethief.png[/img]
[b]Eddga the Thief Event[/b]
2/9/2015~3/9/2015
 
Eddga’s servants have stolen rice cakes imbued with powers at his request. The Northern Dancer needs your help to get them back. Find Eddga’s Servants in fields all over Rune-Midgarts to reclaim the purloined rice cakes!
Eddga’s servants drop all sorts of rice cakes when you challenge them. You can use them as they drop or turn them in with the Northern Dancer in Prontera for different cakes and costumes.
 
[b]Rice Cake[/b]
STR +20, AGI +20, WIL +20,INT +20,Health +20 (10 min duration)
[b]Cactis Rice Cake[/b]
HP +500, EXP +5%  (10 min duration)
[b]Mugwort Rice Cake[/b]
Physical Attack Power+200,Magical Attack Power +200, Drop rate +5% (10 min duration)
[b]Rice Cake Bag[/b]
Physical Attack Power+200 , Magical Attack Power +200,HP +500,EXP +5%, Drop rate +5%, STR +20, AGI +20, WIL +20,INT +20,Health +20 (One Hour effect)
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/NothernDancer.png[/img] 

The [b]Northern Dancer[/b] will trade:
15 Murgwort Rice Cakes for 1 Rice Cake Bag
15 Cactis Rice Cakes for 1 Rice Cake Bag
15 Rice Cakes for 1 Rice Cake Bag
30 Rice Cake Bags for a Traditional Costume Box
15 Rice Cake Bags for a Party Mask Random Box
 
The [b]Traditional Costume Box[/b] gives one item:
Hanbok (M/F)
Kimono (M/F)
Oriental Dress or Suit
These costumes will give you an [b]MP loss decrease of -25% and an item drop rate of +10%[/b] during the duration of the event.
 
The [b]Party Mask Random Box[/b] gives one item:
Wolf Mask (30 days)
Disciple Mask (30 Days)
Queen Mask (30 Days)
Collapsed Mask (30 Days)
Butterfly Mask (30 Days)
Scream Mask (30 Days)
 
Use the Rice Cake drop items during the event. They will vanish after the event ends!

Collect [b]Cacao Beans[/b] and [b]Dark Chocolate[/b] by completing quests and challenging monsters within a 5 level +/- range of your character.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/chocolatecollecting.png[/img]

You can collect [b]Bonbon au Chocolat[/b] and [b]Chocolat Noir[/b] in areas in Rune Midgarts to acquire cacao and chocolate as well!
Bonbons and Chocolat Noir appear in the East & West Mjolnir Mountains, Prontera, Alberta, and Morroc (Except Dayr Desert.) Chocolate Noir gives out Cacao Beans and is relatively easy to find and collect. Bonbons are harder to collect and find, but give out Dark Chocolates.
 
Trade your chocolates in for a [b]Valentine Chocolate Basket.[/b] This item, when used, will give you the title [b]‘Grand Cru’[/b] and complete a new Khara quest 'The Best Title' in your Khara Menu.
This title will give you [b]STR +80, INT +80, AGI +30, WIL +30, Health +30[/b] (Stats double during event.)
 
Trade:
10 Cacao Beans for 1 Dark Chocolate
5 Dark Chocolates for 1 Milk Chocolate
5 Milk Chocolates for 1 Chocolate Cake
30 Chocolates for a Valentine Chocolate Basket
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/ValentinesNPCs.png[/img]
Find NPCs [b]Magery Bruce[/b] and [b]Jon Pestin in Prontera[/b] to start quest lines and trade in items.
 
Need a pick me up while completing these challenges? Dark Chocolate and Milk Chocolate will recover HP when eaten and Chocolate Cake will give you an HP boost of 3000 for an hour!

notes.title: Yule Festival
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/xmas-banner600.jpg[/img]

[h1]Yule Festival[/h1]
12/15/2014~1/12/2015

The holiday season has begun in Rune-Midgarts! Tis the season to be jolly and join in the Yule festivities!
 
A Christmas tree has been erected by the citizens of Prontera to celebrate the Yule holiday! Meet your friends under the tree and make some memories that will last much longer than just this holiday season~ 
 
Starting 12/15/14, Holiday NPCs will appear in RO2 to aid you in your holiday quests! 
Start the journey by finding NPC Dasher in Prontera.
Collect Lutie Snowflakes by completing quests, as drops from monsters within 5 levels above or below your character, and through a Kafra box. You can exchange these snowflakes in Prontera at NPC Rudolph for a costume and titles with a Yule theme!
  
Complete the quest ‘Bless Christmas’ to earn the Christmas Wreath title.
Stats: Physical Attack + 400 / Magical Attack + 400 / Defense +500 / VIT + 150
 
Complete the quest ‘Red-Nosed’ to earn the Christmas Rudolph title.
Stats: Physical Attack + 400 / Magical Attack + 400 /Critical Hit + 150 / Penetration + 50
 
Title stats will double during the event period.

notes.title: NEW: Guild Housing
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/GuildHousing.png[/img]

Guilds in Ragnarok Online 2 can enter a lotto to own a Guild House.

To apply for Guild Housing, visit the Guild House Manager NPC in Prontera or Morroc.
In the Lottery List, enter the lotto by selecting the house you want, the number of tickets you wish to buy and select apply. You can continually buy lotto tickets until the winning guild is announced.

Winners are selected on the 1st and 15th of each month. Winning guilds will retain the house for 28 days.
You can check the status of the lotto by selecting ‘Current State’ from the Guild House Manager NPC’s Menu. This will show a list of other guilds in the lotto, your number of tickets, and current Guild House holders.

A guild can only hold one Guild House at a time. The winning guild will earn a percentage of the lotto ticket revenue pool.
Members of the winning guild will be able to warp to the guild house by using a ‘Warp’ button available in their guild menu.
 
The Guild House has various NPCs inside to help you:
   
    -Guild Dungeon Manager
    -Master Level
    -Guild Manager
    -Robe Merchant
    -Merchant Master
    -Storage Service
    -Potion Merchant
    -Repair expert


An NPC in the Guild House will allow members to warp to the Greedy Mine Dungeon. Vault and Guild house holders will be able to access this special dungeon area with level 80+ monsters.

PvP is open in the Greedy Mine, and players will be able to earn or loose Blood Points while on this map. Bosses in the Greedy Mine drop items such as Seed Runes and Honing Oil.
  
Honing Oil is a new item that will give you a 10% higher range when honing.

notes.title: Morroc War of Emperium
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/morrocwoebanner.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Enter Morroc's War of Emperium![/h1]


The War of Emperium is a guild versus guild siege battle. Your fellow guild members are your battle allies while members of other guilds are your enemies. All the guilds participating will have to compete with each other to attack and take the fortress.
Siege weapons and defensive items will be at your disposal! Attackers gain an advantage by taking smaller Emperiums that will provide your guild with unique buffs. Once the gates are destroyed, attacking guilds will face off against guardians protecting the main fortress Emperium. The guild that destroys the Emperium become the new owners, and will be the defenders of their spoils in the next round of the War of Emperium.
 

[b]War of Emperium Times[/b]
Thursday at 5:00pm PDT
Sunday at 11:00am PDT
 
[b]Features of Morroc War of Emperium[/b]
There are 3 starting points. You can use the flight Kafra service at each entrance during battle.
There are two castles and one fortress that can be sieged. The fortress is closed by 3 gates.
The western castle has an orb that when destroyed will open the eastern gate to the fortress. Destroying the orb in the east castle will open the western gate.
The fortress has 2 key positions, the upper level and bottom level. The top level can be accessed through the western and eastern towers.
Destroying the southern gate will allow players into the lower level that houses the fortress Emperium.
The Garden is north of the fortress and houses various monsters and a boss.
 Morroc WoE Garden

[b]Participation[/b]
Players must be in a guild.
Guilds that are inside or outside of the fortress can participate.
Guilds that own the fortress will can be warped inside the fortress they hold. Guilds that do not own the fortress will be warped to the battlefield.
Talk to the WoE entrance NPCs in Morroc to enter. 
Knight Head Shun will allow players to warp to fortresses.
Knight Subdirector Gyle allows players to warp to one of three starting points.
 
[b]Taking over the Fortress[/b]
Ownership of the fortress is determined by destroying the Emperium. If multiple guilds are assaulting the Emperium, the guild with the most damage dealt will claim the fortress.
Morroc WoE Boss
 
[b]Guild Robes[/b]
Guild members are given robes to distinguish themselves from other guilds during War of Emperium.
The color of the robes is random when first used. Guilds can get different colors for their robes by purchasing new robes and using them.
Guilds can earn different styles of robes by participating in War of Emperium daily quests and earning tokens. They can be bought from the robe merchant next to the guild manager.
 
Morroc WoE Castle
 
[b]Fortress Benefits[/b]
-Guardian NPCs
-Kafra Services
-Warp Points
-Repair Machines
-Siege Catapults (one guild member can buy up to 10 siege catapults) This feature is open to all players.
-Castle Occupation Buff (Increases Max HP by 1,000; Increases movement speed by 15%)
-Fortress Occupation Buff (Increases Max HP by 500; Increases movement speed by 13%)
-Tax Administer: Guild will receive 10% of the Zeny spent at all NPC merchants.
 
[b]PvP Zone[/b]
In the War of Emperium zone. PvP is open. Players can kill other players to earn Blood Points. However, unlike the Colosseum, players will lose Blood Points upon death.
Morroc WoE Castle

notes.title: Dark Whisper
notes.content:
[b]Dark Whisper will include:
[list]
[*]Level Cap Expansion from Master Level 20 to Master Level 30
[*]Two New Field Maps (Lower Dark Whisper and Upper Dark Whisper) with new monsters and bosses
[*]New Items
[*]New Craftable Gear and Weapons
[*]Dayr Desert Monster DNA and Cards[/list][/b]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/upstair_mainimage_8area.jpg[/img]

It is known that the Curse of Osiris gave rise to the Fortress of Despair. Though the Day of Despair came to an end, and Dark Whisper joined the Defeated Freyja in Vanaheim, dimensional cracks appeared throughout Ashkaron and woke the dark power.
 
With the fall of Ashkaron, Dark Whisper's owner, Valkyrie Himmelmez, captured the remnants of the Ashkaron Empire easily. This victory came with a heavy cost, as the dimensional cracks weakened and Dark Whisper's power ebbed. In order to hold what she had, Himmelmez went into hibernation, collecting power for the day she might have the strength to awaken once more.
 
Several years have passed since these events transpired, and with the summoning of the dimensional cracks throughout Rune-Midgarts by Freyja, Vanaheim's power has returned. While there was not enough power to summon the Valkyries, the use of Saintess Aione's power to seal these dimensional cracks revealed to the awakened Himmelmez that Randgris's power lays inside the Saintess.
 
"Now is the time.."
 
Valkyrie Himmelmez stirs, her dark power felt throughout the land, and she is swiftly regaining more power as she absorbs the strength of Valkyrie Randgris from Saintess Aione.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/downstair_mainimage_1area.jpg[/img]

[b]Set-up[/b]
 
Valkyrie Himmelmez has built huge fortresses with the purpose of researching dark magic. The lower level is filled with her failed monstrous experiments. The upper level contains her successes, monsters with the strength to act as Valkyrie Himmelmez's bodyguards. It should be noted that while these monsters have greater strength, their weakness lies in a lack of focus, as their attention has turned on monster collection rather than protecting their maker.
 
[b]Introduction[/b]
 
The Dark Whisper Upper and Lower hunting fields are for Master Level 20+ players. You can enjoy the hunting fields with Dayr Desert and Osiris gears, but prepare to battle Valkyrie Himmelmez with new and powerul weapons.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/upstair_7-area_02.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/downstair_4-area_02.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/downstair_2-area_01.jpg[/img]

[b]Bosses[/b]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/1.jpg[/img]

Parent Basilisk
 
Basilisk lives in the Ashkaron subterranean cave which causes him to have terrible eyesight. However, his sense of smell is exceptional, and his hearing is parallel to none. After the Ashkaron castle collapsed, Himmelmez found this monster and made a nest for him on the lower level
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/2.png[/img]
 
Trainer Kurolf
 
Kurolf is the older twin brother of Himmelmez’s subordinate Gustaf. He is much stronger than Gustaf, but he is also very lazy and dumb. There was one time when he was asked to train Rackufs on Himmelmez’s orders. By the end of the training, all the Rackufs were dead. He is still training Rackufs, but now he is working hard not to make the same mistake twice. 
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/3.jpg[/img]
 
Queen Arwen
 
Arwen is a half human, half arachnid monster created by Himmelmez. Due to Arwen’s low intelligence and battle ability, Himmelmez threw her away. Regardless, she is still one of the cruelest queen spiders around. 
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/4.jpg[/img]
 
Supervisor Gustaf
 
Gustaf is Kurolf’s younger twin brother who trains laborers. While smarter than his brother, he is just as cruel. Don’t compare him to his brother though or he may get offended.
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/5.jpg[/img]
 
Armdieras
 
The great grand masters decaying corpses combine to create the gruesome Armdieras. There is a core that controls him, manipulated by Himmelmez which gives this monstrosity the power to move. This core resides within the twisted flesh of this monsters body.
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/6.jpg[/img]
 
Chef Gurush
 
Gurush was once a chef in Ashkaron, but he was killed in his kitchen when Ashkaron collapsed. Fortunately, Himmelmez revived him. However, those who wished to eat his food again are out of luck, because his cooking abilities are completely gone. He is now just a greedy monster. 
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/7.jpg[img]
 
Bijou the Witch
 
When Bijou was alive, she helped Himmelmez in her twisted research. However, when the Day of Despair came, Bijou was killed in battle. Himmelmez, feeling pity for her former ally, and not wanting to lose a valuable resource, gave her life again. To ensure her death would not be revisited, Himmelmez gifted her with huge arms of killing force, so that Bijou might protect herself should the need arise again.

[b]How to get to Dark Whisper[/b]

The entrance will be located in Morroc City, next to the Tomb of Osiris entrance. 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/dwmap1.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/dwmap-2-e1402355332247.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/dwmap-3-e1402355349563.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dark Whisper
notes.content:
[b]Dark Whisper will include:
[list]
[*]Level Cap Expansion from Master Level 20 to Master Level 30
[*]Two New Field Maps (Lower Dark Whisper and Upper Dark Whisper) with new monsters and bosses
[*]New Items
[*]New Craftable Gear and Weapons
[*]Dayr Desert Monster DNA and Cards[/list][/b]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/upstair_mainimage_8area.jpg[/img]

It is known that the Curse of Osiris gave rise to the Fortress of Despair. Though the Day of Despair came to an end, and Dark Whisper joined the Defeated Freyja in Vanaheim, dimensional cracks appeared throughout Ashkaron and woke the dark power.
 
With the fall of Ashkaron, Dark Whisper's owner, Valkyrie Himmelmez, captured the remnants of the Ashkaron Empire easily. This victory came with a heavy cost, as the dimensional cracks weakened and Dark Whisper's power ebbed. In order to hold what she had, Himmelmez went into hibernation, collecting power for the day she might have the strength to awaken once more.
 
Several years have passed since these events transpired, and with the summoning of the dimensional cracks throughout Rune-Midgarts by Freyja, Vanaheim's power has returned. While there was not enough power to summon the Valkyries, the use of Saintess Aione's power to seal these dimensional cracks revealed to the awakened Himmelmez that Randgris's power lays inside the Saintess.
 
"Now is the time.."
 
Valkyrie Himmelmez stirs, her dark power felt throughout the land, and she is swiftly regaining more power as she absorbs the strength of Valkyrie Randgris from Saintess Aione.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/downstair_mainimage_1area.jpg[/img]

[b]Set-up[/b]
 
Valkyrie Himmelmez has built huge fortresses with the purpose of researching dark magic. The lower level is filled with her failed monstrous experiments. The upper level contains her successes, monsters with the strength to act as Valkyrie Himmelmez's bodyguards. It should be noted that while these monsters have greater strength, their weakness lies in a lack of focus, as their attention has turned on monster collection rather than protecting their maker.
 
[b]Introduction[/b]
 
The Dark Whisper Upper and Lower hunting fields are for Master Level 20+ players. You can enjoy the hunting fields with Dayr Desert and Osiris gears, but prepare to battle Valkyrie Himmelmez with new and powerul weapons.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/upstair_7-area_02.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/downstair_4-area_02.jpg[/img]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/downstair_2-area_01.jpg[/img]

[b]Bosses[/b]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/1.jpg[/img]

Parent Basilisk
 
Basilisk lives in the Ashkaron subterranean cave which causes him to have terrible eyesight. However, his sense of smell is exceptional, and his hearing is parallel to none. After the Ashkaron castle collapsed, Himmelmez found this monster and made a nest for him on the lower level
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/2.png[/img]
 
Trainer Kurolf
 
Kurolf is the older twin brother of Himmelmez’s subordinate Gustaf. He is much stronger than Gustaf, but he is also very lazy and dumb. There was one time when he was asked to train Rackufs on Himmelmez’s orders. By the end of the training, all the Rackufs were dead. He is still training Rackufs, but now he is working hard not to make the same mistake twice. 
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/3.jpg[/img]
 
Queen Arwen
 
Arwen is a half human, half arachnid monster created by Himmelmez. Due to Arwen’s low intelligence and battle ability, Himmelmez threw her away. Regardless, she is still one of the cruelest queen spiders around. 
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/4.jpg[/img]
 
Supervisor Gustaf
 
Gustaf is Kurolf’s younger twin brother who trains laborers. While smarter than his brother, he is just as cruel. Don’t compare him to his brother though or he may get offended.
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/5.jpg[/img]
 
Armdieras
 
The great grand masters decaying corpses combine to create the gruesome Armdieras. There is a core that controls him, manipulated by Himmelmez which gives this monstrosity the power to move. This core resides within the twisted flesh of this monsters body.
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/6.jpg[/img]
 
Chef Gurush
 
Gurush was once a chef in Ashkaron, but he was killed in his kitchen when Ashkaron collapsed. Fortunately, Himmelmez revived him. However, those who wished to eat his food again are out of luck, because his cooking abilities are completely gone. He is now just a greedy monster. 
 
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/7.jpg[img]
 
Bijou the Witch
 
When Bijou was alive, she helped Himmelmez in her twisted research. However, when the Day of Despair came, Bijou was killed in battle. Himmelmez, feeling pity for her former ally, and not wanting to lose a valuable resource, gave her life again. To ensure her death would not be revisited, Himmelmez gifted her with huge arms of killing force, so that Bijou might protect herself should the need arise again.

The entrance will be located in Morroc City, next to the Tomb of Osiris entrance.

[h1]Instagram to Win![/h1]

It is the century of sharing selfies and pictures of your dogs, so we have recently decided to join in on this fun as well! For the month of June, we will be hosting a number of events on a wonderful little application called Instagram!

The most creative pictures will be put into a special collage that will be posted onto our Ragnarok 2 Facebook page! 

Additionally, everyone who posts in this category will have their names be put into a raffle. [b]One lucky winner will get a Popopoporing Mount (90 days)[/b]!

notes.title: End of May Anniversary Bonus!
notes.content:
It is almost the end of our 1st year Anniversary celebration in May, and we will be holding one last special event to celebrate! Let us welcome summer with open arms!
 
From [b]May 21 to May 28[/b], when you purchase more than [b]1000 Kafra Points[/b], you will be rewarded with some fantastic items! 
 
Those who purchase [b]1000 or more Kafra Points will receive a Tame Sapphire Mount (30 Days, untradeable)[/b]. 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/sapphore.jpg[/img]
 
Those who purchase [b]2500 or more Kafra Points will receive an Anniversary Hat (2 Rune Slots) and the Tame Sapphire Mount (30 Days)[/b]. The Anniversary Hats will be leaving at the end of the event, which means you will never have the chance to get them again! 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/annihat111.jpg[/img]

*All rewards will be sent at the END of the event period to your temporary storage. Only 1 of each reward will be sent per WP account.
*Steam and Aeria users are eligible, as long as they purchase Kafra points within the event period.

notes.title: Team Angeling vs Team Deviling
notes.content:
[url=http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/198]Click here to go to event page![/url]


Are you ready for an epic new event? As many of you know, Ragnarok 2 is celebrating its first anniversary this May. Our two mascots to mark this great event are the Angeling and Deviling. 
 
So now it's time for you to decide. Are you ... 

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/an2.png[/img]

Show your support for your side by participating in our new events!
 
--------------------------
 
[h1]The Ultimate CM Team Battle[/h1]
 
 
Njoror will be leading Team Deviling while Zanbee will be leading Team Angeling. There will be consequences for these two leaders if one of them loses. 
 
[b]The Consequences:[/b]


If Njoror loses, he will be dared to sing a karaoke song of the community's choosing (we'll host a vote and everything!)


If Zanbee loses, she will do the hot pepper challenge for This Week in Ragnarok. The pepper chosen may or may not be a habanero. 	
 
 
[b]How points will be calculated:[/b]
 
Twitter Hashtag Posts: 1 point each
Facebook Picture Likes: 0.5 points per like (starting on May 6th)
Normal Entry into the Creative Event: 2 points per submission 
Themed Entry into the Creative Event: 3 points per submission
 
 --------------------------
 
[h1]Choose Your Team Hashtag Event[/h1]
 
 
From May 5th to June 2nd, post with the Hashtag [b]#TeamAngeling or #TeamDeviling, along with #Ragnarok2[/b], to show your support for your team! Each hashtag will generate one point for your team. Please only post one hashtag per week, per account during the event period. 
 
Every week, we will host a raffle to give away 5 temporary Poring Hats to lucky winners. 
 
[b]Be sure to follow our Twitters as well![/b]
 
 
Ragnarok 2's Twitter
twitter.com/playragnarok2
 
Zanbee's Twitter	
twitter.com/ozanbee

Njoror's Twitter	 
twitter.come/cm_njoror
	


 
 
 --------------------------
 
[h1]Choose Your Team Free-for-all Creative Event[/h1]
 
 
We host a lot of creative events for Ragnarok 2, and this time we will be doing it a little differently. Instead of asking you to enter a specific entry, we will be hosting a free-for-all creative event. 
 
[b]You can submit a Normal (related to Ragnarok 2) or Themed (related to Team Angeling/Deviling) version of the following:
[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Arts and Crafts:[/b]This can be fan-art or crafts made in real life. 
[*][b]Lyrics or Short Stories:[/b] Compose your own lyrics to a well-known song, or write a Short Story (has be less than 500 words). If you are composing lyrics, please sing the song (optional). If you are writing a short story, please include a cover image.  
[*][b]Video:[/b] Create your own Ragnarok related video.                              
[*][b]Other:[/b]Want to do something different from the categories above? Choose this category! This can be open-ended, such as making your own recipe of a food that can be found in Ragnarok 2, baking a Poring cake, cosplay, etc. 
 [/list]
 
 
If you are unsure of where to submit your entry, feel free to ask CM Zanbee via forums. 
 
 
 
[b]Rules:[/b]
 
1. Entry period: May 5- June 2
2. You may submit one entry per category for the creative event (up to 4 total). 
3. You can only choose one side for the entirety of the event and for all your creative submissions.
4. All submissions have to be your own original work.
5. Please enter work that has not been shared with the community or submitted for other Ragnarok 2 contests. 
6. Submissions have to be appropriate for all ages. We reserve the right to revoke any submissions we deem inappropriate or against forum and event rules.
7. Please submit entries in our forum thread or the Steam event entry thread.
8. Please fill out the following form when submitting entries:
 
[list]
     [*]Character Name:
     [*]Team:
     [*]Why you chose this team:
     [*]Entry Category: 
     [*]*Attach Entry
 [/list]
 
[b]Prizes:[/b]
 
There will be one winner per each category (to be decided by Warpportal Staff and Volunteers), and one Arts and Craft winner chosen via Facebook Likes. 
 
These five winners will be receiving Ragnarok 2 mousepads! They will be signed by Zanbee, Njoror, Heimdallr and other select Warpportal staff members!
 
All creative participants will be recieving a 30 day accessory and an Event Random Box.
 
 ----------------------
 
 
*Thanks to Doppio for the first three pictures! 
*Volunteers not involved in the voting process are eligible to enter.

notes.title: Jump to New Heights
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/1000x320.jpg[/img]

Our newsletters are a great way of catching up with game news and updates. For a short period of time, everyone who has opted in to recieve the newsletters will be getting a [b]free jump to level 50 on a new character [/b] as a token of thanks! Additionally, all new Ragnarok 2 accounts made between [b]May 1st to June 2nd[/b] will also get one free jump on a new character. 

 

From [b]May 1st to June 2nd[/b], be sure to sign up for the Warpportal newsletter. We will be giving away to qualified accounts one free jump to level 50 for a new character. Please know that jump can only be used when creating a new character and not on an existing character.

 

Make sure you are signed up by a Wednesday if you would like to get your free jump by the following Thursday. You may only claim one free jump during the event period. 

 

If you are already signed up for the newsletter, your account will automatically get the Jump character option on Thursday, [b]May 8th[/b].

 

Please remember that Monday, [b]June 2nd[/b] will be the last day to qualify for the free jump. The last day to claim the free jump will be on [b]June 15th[/b]!

notes.title: Happy Birthday Ragnarok 2- Anniversary Events!!
notes.content:
We made it! Ragnarok 2 is officially a year old on May 1st! Say a "Happy Birthday" by hopping in game and participating in our exciting Anniversary Event! 

[h1][b]Anniversary Quests[/b][/h1]

To start the anniversary event quests, find ClinkZ near the Prontera Fountain. Click on "Very Important Request" to accept the quest.

When you finish the quest line at NPC Brate, be sure to talk to Zeras Hyperion for the second part of the quests.

Completing the quest line will give the following rewards: 
 
[list][*]1 Day Elite VIP
[*]1 Large Bag
[*]2 Phantom Stones
[*]2 Adventure Battle Manuals[/list]

Additionally, there will be two new daily quests where you can earn Anniversary Tokens. Look for NPC's Angelica and Devilica in Prontera.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/angelica-item-list.jpg[/img]

Trade in your Anniversary Tokens at NPC Angelica for cool prizes!

Here are the items you can trade in Anniversary Tokens for:

[list]
[*]1st Annivesary Hat- 3 Anniversary Tokens
[*]VIP Membership Card (30 days)- 10 Anniversary Tokens
[*]VIP Membership Card (1 day)- 1 Anniversary Token
[*]First Anniversary Card Random Box- 3 Anniversary Tokens
[*]Master Battle Manual Orders- 2 Anniversary Tokens
[*]Phantom Stone- 1 Anniversary Token
[/list]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/annivip.jpg[/img]
VIP Membership Card

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/annihat-e1398292256221.jpg[/img]
1st Year Anniversary Hat

[h1][b] Anniversary Letter Collection[/b][/h1]

As part of our 1st Anniversary celebration, we will be hosting another Letter Collection event! All you have to do is collect Broken Pieces and trade them in! 
 
The following Broken Pieces can be obtained via monster drops. 
  [list][*]Broken Piece A
  [*]Broken Piece N
  [*]Broken Piece I
  [*]Broken Piece V
  [*]Broken Piece E
  [*]Broken Piece R
  [*]Broken Piece S
  [*]Broken Piece ANNI[/list]
 
You can then trade in the Broken Pieces at the Kafra Service for some fantastic items!

notes.title: Spring Festival
notes.content:
[url=http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/188]Click here to go to officla event page![/url]

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/bunnies-title.jpg[/img]

The great season of Spring is here, and there is no shortage of blooming flowers and hopping bunnies! 

To start the [Spring Festival] Quests, look for NPC Clinkz in front of the Prontera Fountain. You have to be level 15 before you can see the quests.

[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/pranked.png[/img]

Completing the Spring festival quest line will give you [b]The Pranked[/b] Khara Title (+12 STR, +12 AGI, +12 INT, +8 WIS, +18 VIT). 

Through this event, you can collect Easter Eggs by completing quests or getting them as monster drops. 

 [url=http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/egss-list.jpg]Click here for Easter Egg contents![/url]

Right-clicking a bunny will either give you a Bunny with a higher level or a Sulky Bunny. 

The Spring Festival [b]Easter Bunny Box[/b] is also selling in the Kafra Shop for 30 Kafra points! Purchase the box and you have a chance of getting a level 10 Bunny! 

The box has a chance of giving 1 of the following:
Bunny (Lv 2)
Bunny (Lv 3)
Bunny (Lv 4)
Bunny (Lv 5)
Bunny (Lv 6)
Bunny (Lv 7)
Bunny (Lv 8)
Bunny (Lv 9)
Bunny (Lv 10)
Sulky Bunny


If you get a Bunny (Lv 10), then you will be able to complete the "[Spring Festival] Easter Bunny" Khara quest which gives a [b]Easter Bunny[/b] Khara Title (2% Additional Damage, 2% Additional AGI, +30 Penetration, 1% Damage Reduction).

If you right-click a Bunny and it fails, it will turn into a Sulky Bunny. You can collect Sulky Bunnies and trade for items from NPC Tokki.

You can also trade in Sulky Bunnies at NPC Big Bunny for new Khara titles.
 

Title Name: [b][Spring Festival] Pascha[/b]
Cost: 50 Sulky Bunnies
Stat: +28 STR, +15 AGI, +25 VIT

Title Name: [b][Spring Festival] Ostern[/b]
Cost: 50 Sulky Bunnies
Stat: +28 INT, +15 AGI, +25 VIT

Title Name: [b][Spring Festival] Eostore[/b]
Cost: 50 Sulky Bunnies
Stat: +40 VIT, +50 Parry, +100 Hit
 

 *All [Spring Festival] Special Event Khara Titles will have double stats until May 14th.

notes.title: Imagination Rules the World! Short Story Contest
notes.content:
[h1]Imagination Rules the World! Short Story Contest[/h1]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/shortstory-banner.jpg[/img]
 
It's time to put your imaginations to the test as we bring to you our first Ragnarok 2 "Imagination Rules the World" Short Story contest! 
 
[b]Here are the rules:[/b]
 [list]
[*]1. The story has to be related to Ragnarok Online 2, or Norse Mythology. 
 
[*]2. All entries must include an image or screenshot that represents the story. These images will be gathered and posted to an album on our Facebook along with the stories. Submitting multiple images to go along with your story is allowed, but please limit the number of pictures to 10 images. (If you do not wish your story to go on FB, please state so in your entry).
 
[*]3. The story has to be original, unpublished, and never been submitted before to other contests.
 
[*]4. The story has to be written entirely by the person who submits it.  
 
[*]5. Entries have to be in English. In case the author is foreign, a translator may be used.
 
[*]6. Entries need to have at least 300 words (English words, not letters) but no more than 3000 words.
 
[*]7. All stories have to be age appropriate. Forum rules will apply to entries. No exceptions.
 
[*]8. The event will not accept entries posted after 11:59pm March 31st. Please allow up to 2-3 weeks for judging and prizes.
 
[*]9. Please use the following format when submitting:
   
     Character Name:
    Title of Short Story:
    Image and then Short Story Entry
    # of words:
 
[*]10. Please submit your entries in our forum thread, or in our Steam Event Entry Thread.
 [/list]
[b]Criteria for Judging:[/b]
 
Warpportal Staff members and the Volunteer Event Planners will judge the entries out of five stars on the following:
 [list]
[*]Originality (Have we read stories like this before? How is it different from the other entries? Are we likely to remember this story after we finished reading?)
 
[*]Story Flow (How well did the story come together? Did we take several breaks in between reading because we got lost, or did everything just make sense from beginning to end?) 
 
[*]Interest Factor (Did it make us laugh, cry, or become afraid of the dark at night?)
 
[*]Creativity (Is that the sun, or a massive fireball so powerful and gleaming that we all have to lower our eyes in its unearthly presence?)
[/list]
*Points will be added together at the end of the judging period. In the case of ties, judges will rank the entries based on internal discussion.
 
[b]Prizes:[/b]
 
The top 3 authors will win a permanent Fox and Wolf set. 
 
There may be Honorable Mention winners (winning a Fox and Wolf Random Box)
 
Additionally, all participants will receive an Event Random Box, an Event Dye, and a 30 day accessory (tbd).
 
 
*Prizes, rules and dates subject to change at anytime.

notes.title: Valentine's Day: All You Need Is Love
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/vday.jpg[/img]

[b]Love is in the air, and there are 5 new Khara titles and 2 new costumes to celebrate Valentine's Day with! All you have to do is to collect Cacaos from Monster Hunting or by purchasing the Valentine Chocolate Box through the Kafra Shop, and trade them in![/b]

You can trade in Cacaos, Chocolates, Chocolate Creams, or Chocolate Cakes at NPC Magery Bruce located at the center of Prontera City. Once you have enough Chocolate Cakes for the Chocolatier Title, you can accept and complete the quest from Magery Bruce. 

[b]Item list from Magery Bruce:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cacao: Monster Drop, Collecting in the WoE Map
[*]Chocolate: Exchange with 10 Cacaos or from the Valentine Chocolate Box
[*]Chocolate Creams: Exchange with 10 Chocolates or from the Valentine Chocolate Box
[*]Chocolate Cake: Exchange with 10 Chocolate Creams or from the Valentine Chocolate Box[/list]

When you have collected enough Chocolate Cakes, you can visit NPC John Prestin and exchange the Cakes for items. To get a title, accept one of the quests he offers. The Khara Titles you can get from John Prestin are Biscotti, Truffle, Palet'dor, and Couverture. 

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/chocvo1.jpg[/img]

[b]Limited Time RO1 Dancer and Bard Costumes: [/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/Rag2-2014-01-29-11-28-48-27.png[/img]  RO1 Dancer Style Costume

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/Rag2-2014-01-29-11-30-56-03.png[/img] RO1 Bard Style Costume

[b]VEP Events[/b]

Star Crossed Greetings: [url=http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/143434-star-crossed-greetings/]Click here![/url]

A Tribute to Love Poetry Event: [url=http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/143814-poetry-event-a-tribute-to-love/]Click here![/url]

notes.title: Free Master Battle Manual Orders on 12/23
notes.content:
Today we introduced the Master Levels, an exciting and extensive way to improve your character with spending Mastery Points.  One way to improve the gain of Mastery Points is with the Kafra Shop item "Master Battle Manual Orders", which give a 30 min 50% gain on Mastery Points from monsters.
 
We have listened to feedback about the duration and buff power and have decided on December 23rds maintenance to change the buff duration from 30min -> 24hour while retaining the 200pt price.  To be totally fair and to thank all of you who have tried out the Master Battle Manual orders (MBMO) from December 18th implementation until that maintenance on the 23rd, we will give you 1 MBMO in return for each one you've consumed. 
 
This basically means use a bunch now when they are at the shorter duration and we will give you free ones at the longer 24hour duration during the maintenance!  So get some free ones on us this weekend!
 
Happy Holidays!
