notes.title: Morroc Around the Clock Dance Contest
notes.content:
From December 11th, 2013 to January 8th, 2014, submit your best dancing videos for a chance at earning awesome prizes! 

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/12/Rag2-2013-06-18-15-13-58-96-e1387233293957.png[/img]
 
[b]Here are the rules:[/b]
 
1. The video has to be uploaded on Youtube, or a similar video sharing site. Please submit the link in the forum thread, in the Steam forum Event Submission thread, or via a Facebook message. Please also remember to include your Character Name.
2. The video has to include "Ragnarok 2: MACD" in the title. 
3.  The following are allowed:
[list]  [*]In game footage of characters dancing to music, similar to a music video or edited so that the character performs a new dance.
  [*]Real life video of you performing a new dance.
     *If you choose this option, please write www.playragnarok2.com + your character name on a piece of paper and show it to the camera before performing your dance. Please perform an original dance. 
  [*]Group dances, in game footage or in real life (rule above still apply). [/list]
4. Please try your best to use music that is not copyrighted. This is not a requirement, but doing so would  ensure that we get to see your video. 
5. The videos have to be appropriate for all ages and relevant to the game. 
 
 
There will be three Grand Prize winners, one for each of the following categories:
 
 
Best Dance: In Game Footage
Best Dance: Real Life Footage
Most Popular: The video with the most views
 
 
The Grand Prize includes a Super Large Bag, 10 Karniums, and the winner's choice of a permanent costume set (any costume set that has already been released in game prior to December 11th, 2013 are eligible). Only 1 Grand Prize per winning entry. *If you are the owner of a winning entry, and you would like the individual prizes to be sent to different accounts, please send Zanbee a request via forum private message.
 
Participation prize will be an Event Box. If your video has more than one participant, please list all the character names with the submission.
 
Winners will be determined by the WP Staff. 
 
 
*Event date and prizes subject to change at anytime.

notes.title: Ragnarok 2 Lyrical Masterpiece Challenge
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/11/lyricalbanner.png[/img]

[url=http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/153]Click here for event page[/url]

Vocali's Barbershop Quartet presents their "Lyrical Masterpiece Challenge!" Have you ever dreamed of hearing Zanbee and Njoror sing 'Ice Ice Titans'? Create your own lyrics themed around Ragnarok Online based upon your favorite.. or most hated, Holiday/Winter Themed songs! The top song will be sung by select WP staff members. It will have Swag!
 
[b]Here are the rules:[/b]

1. Create Ragnarok related and inspired lyrics to a notable holiday song. Please write lyrics to a whole song.
2. It has to be appropriate for all ages, and cannot contain any profanity, mature or racist themes, etc. 
3. Please use this format when submitting:
    Character Name (IGN) and Server:
    Name of Song Used + Link to Existing Video or Original Song:
    Name of Your Song:
    Lyrics:
    (Optional) Bonus Video/Audio:
4. In addition to submitting the Lyrics, you may also win a Bonus Prize if you record yourself singing the lyrics you wrote. 
5. Warpportal will select the winning song, and if things go well, will perform the song. 
6. Please submit entries via our forum thread here: http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/137021-ro2-lyrical-masterpiece-challenge/
7. The last day to submit will be 12/4. 
 
[b]Prize:[/b]
 
The Grand Prize Winner will get a permanent Mount and a permanent Santa Set (costume+wings+hat). 
Bonus prize will be a temporary costume TBD. 
Participation prize will be temporary accessory TBD. 
(Only one of each prize per account.)
 
*Prizes and rules subject to change at anytime.

notes.title: Winter Spectacular Loading Screens Contest
notes.content:
Winter Spectacular Loading Screens Contest

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/11/HP-Xmas-e1384911498512.png[/img]

The smell of winter is in air and to celebrate the upcoming holiday season, we are looking for some new Holiday or Winter Ragnarok 2 themed loading screens to be implement in game for a limited time. 
 
[b]Here are the rules:[/b]
 
-It has to follow the theme of Winter, Christmas, or New Year and has to be Ragnarok 2 related
-The size minimum is  1920x1080  . However, the bigger the better. When you post your image in the forum, it does not have to be this size. Do send Zanbee the original image file in a private message as well when you enter your submission. 
-File should be in DDS format. We will also accept PSD or JPG formats.
-The work has to be original and created entirely by the entrant. Modified in-game screenshots allowed.
-Has to be appropriate for all ages
-Entries will be accepted until 12/1. 
-All entries will be posted into a Facebook album. 
-To enter, please submit your images into this thread or via FB message:  http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/136504-winter-spectacular-ls-entry-thread/
-Please include your IGN along with your submission.
 
[b]Prizes:[/b] 
There will be 4 winners to be determined by the Warpportal staff. 
Winners will get a Temporary Mount, and the Viking Costume set. 
Participatory prize: TBD. 
 
Have a fantastic time! 
 
 
*This event is subject to change at anytime.

notes.title: Bewitched Points Conversion for VIP Card Event
notes.content:
[b]Bewitched VIP Membership Card when you convert your Warp Portal Energy![/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/10/Rag2-2013-10-22-17-22-21-20.png[/img]

During the month of October there are tons of exiting events and promotions going on, celebrating the creatures that inhabit Midgard. Prankish spirits have cast a strange spell over our Warpportal page during our Monster's Month in Midgard!

[b]From Tuesday 10/22 until Monday 11/4, when you convert at least 500 WPE into Kafra points, you will get a 7 day VIP Membership Card added to that account![/b]

Only one VIP Membership Card per account, the VIP Membership Card is added on the following Tuesdays and Fridays after the conversion is made.

In Ragnarok 2, VIP can be used for many things, including:
 

-Increases STR, INT, AGI, WIS, and VIT by 5

-Increases max HP by 10%

-Increases max SP by 10%

-Movement Speed increased by 20%

-Item Drop Rate increased by 30%

-Chance to obtain additional instance dungeon winner's points
 

The betwitchment only lasts until the 4th so convert today! Don't forget that your first point conversion of October is boosted to 20% too!

notes.title: Halloween Events!
notes.content:
Get Spooky! October Events

There are quite a number of events this month to celebrate Halloween! Better get those bags ready for some treats!

-----
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/10/pumpkin.png[/img]
	
Halloween Khara Title

For a limited time you can collect pumpkins for a chance to get special Holloween themed Khara Titles.

[url=http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/135]*Click here for more info[/url]

-----

Kafra Service Trick-or-Treating!

Kafras will be giving away 1 Rotten Pumpkin to every Trick or Treater. Alberta and Prontera Kafras will be giving away 3 Rotten Pumpkins. 

-----
	
Halloween Quests

New NPC Lili in Alberta will give you brand new daily quests to complete. Hunt down specific monsters or do specific tasks, and when completed, Fresh Pumpkins will be given as rewards. 

-----

[url=http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/132]*Click here for more info[/url]

You can also get a special Halloween Accessory Box by trading in pumpkins.

notes.title: First Point Conversion Bonus for October
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/10/NoticelHeader_02.jpg[/img]
 
As an exciting bonus for October we are giving 20% bonus points for your first conversion of the month.

An example of this is normally when you convert 900 WP -> Kafra points you will get a special 1 time per month bonus of 5% to the points giving you 945; in October we are giving 20% so you would get 1080 game points! This bonus does stack with the normal conversion tiers as well, so if you convert at the highest tier you will get 40% bonus points!

This is a great time to convert big and and get a BIG bonus to get more value out of your WarpPortal Energy!

In November the bonus returns to 5%!

notes.title: Midgard's Finest Film Festival
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/09/small-white-mfff-banner.png[/url]

Last month, many of you showcased your creativity via the Creative Porings Competition. This month, we would love to see that creativity take the shape and form of creative videos.
 
Check below for the rules and prizes:
 
Rules:
 
-Make a creative video showcasing your Noel Characters. If you don't plan on using Noel characters, you can also create videos using Human characters or are Ro2 related.
-Can be in story or music video format.
-No less than 2 minutes, and no longer than 6 minutes.
-Has to be appropriate for all ages, and relevant to the game.
-You can work in groups, but only one prize per winning entry and account.
-The video has to be uploaded onto Youtube including this in the title "Ragnarok 2 MFFF: Video Name". Be sure to also include your character name and a small summary of your video.
-The last day to submit videos would be on 10/30. To enter, post the video link in the MFFF video thread.
-The WP team will choose 15 videos for a forum poll. The top two will be the first and second place winners chosen by the community.
-There will be two first place and two second place winners: One first and second place chosen by the WP staff and one first and second place by the community.
 
Prizes:
 
First Place: Superlarge bag, VIP Package, 10 Karniums, 2 random costume boxes. and choice of 1 Ro1 costume
 
Second Place: Storage Slot Expansion, 7 day VIP, 5 Karniums, 5 Spinel, 1 random costume box, and choice of 1 Ro1 costume
 
Honorary: The video with the most views will win their choice of 1 Ro1 costume. 
 
 
 
*Please be aware that dates and prizes can change at anytime.

notes.content:

We apologize for the impromptu patch, if it caught some of you off guard, but we wanted to make sure we got some fixes in before the weekend.

notes.title: 9/11 Maintenance Steam Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.

This patch we attempted to upload a new client so that Steam would update your client and you wouldn't have to sit through the patcher's downloading process. We ran into an error this morning, and could not go through with that method. Instead, we suggest you utilize the manual patch to download the 1.6GB patch files if you don't want to wait for the patcher.

Link: http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/122

You'll want to take the RTP files and drop them into the "Patches" folder in your RO2 directory. From there, there is only a small patch that fixes some bugs and sound issues.

We apologize for getting this news to you so late, if we had known sooner we would've let you know about the manual patch sooner.

We hope to see you in the new zone, leveling as a Noel!

notes.content:

This patch we attempted to upload a new client so that Steam would update your client and you wouldn't have to sit through the patcher's downloading process. We ran into an error this morning, and could not go through with that method. Instead, we suggest you utilize the manual patch to download the 1.6GB patch files if you don't want to wait for the patcher.

Link: http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/122

You'll want to take the RTP files and drop them into the "Patches" folder in your RO2 directory. From there, there is only a small patch that fixes some bugs and sound issues.

We apologize for getting this news to you so late, if we had known sooner we would've let you know about the manual patch sooner.

We hope to see you in the new zone, leveling as a Noel!

notes.title: 9/8 WoE Issue
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.
 
During last Wednesday's maintenance period, a 400 player limit was applied to WoE as a temporary measure so that the studio had time to investigate what was causing the crashes from last Sunday. We realized after we put in the population cap that it caused another issue.
 
For the first 400 players that enter WoE, they will be fine. For players 401 and above, they will become stuck if they try and enter WoE. The method to fix this is to change channels.
 
We understand this is a big problem. The studio did not have enough time to come up with a hotfix for this problem, but we are planning on putting one in on next Wednesday's maintenance period.
 
So, for this Sunday only, if you find yourself stuck while trying to enter WoE, it is because the map has met it's 400 player limit, and you've ran into the bug. Change channels to fix your character.
 
We apologize for this inconvenience, it is frustrating and annoying, and we are going to fix it next Wednesday.
 
To re-iterate, WoE on Sunday will happen at the scheduled time, but there will be a population bug that occurs.

notes.title: The Creative Porings Competition
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/08/1185864_10200933481752677_1471293004_n.jpg[/img]

*Drawing courtesy of yours truly Cm Zanbee. 

Monster collection came out and we all like pets. There are many poring-related monsters in the Ro2 world such as the Poor Porings or Adventure-King Poring. If you were to make your own poring pet, what would it look like and how would it act? Create a concept for a new Poring-like monster that would be able to survive in Rune-Midgarts.	

Please use this format when entering:
Your character name
Name of Poring like monster:
What is its favorite food?
What is its personality like and what does it like to do?
If this pet could talk, what would be its favorite phrase?
Short story/Detailed Description (has to be more than 100 words)
Attach Concept art
 
Rules and dates:

-You may submit more than one, but only one prize per account; Images have be submitted by Sept 13th.
-Voting lasts until Sept 18th. Winners announced on the 21st.
-Please post entries via our Fb wall or in the forum thread
-There will be two winners:
    =One will be chosen by the users via FB voting
    =The second winner be chosen by the WP staff
 
 To go to the forum thread, [url=http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/129737-creative-porings-competition/]click here[/url].

notes.title: War of Emperium Events
notes.content:
[b]Guild EXP Surge[/b]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/cpLle5y.jpg?1[/IMG]
Date: 7/3-7/17
Guilds will receive 2x the normal guild experience from guild member donations to help them prepare for the War of Emperium.

[b]All Your Base Are Belong To Us[/b]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/bhyYOYs.jpg?1[/IMG]
Date: July 10 – August 7
Within the War of Emperium test month, we want to reward those guilds who have successfully won War of Emperium. We will be rewarding the following guilds with unique items:
Grand Prize: Guild with most amount of War of Emperium wins
Gold Prize: Top 3 Guilds with most amount of War of Emperium wins
Silver Prize: Top 5 Guilds with most amount of War of Emperium wins
Participation Prize: All Guilds who get at least one War of Emperium win
*Prizes to be announced

[b]The Inquisitive Guild[/b]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Gj00xvM.jpg?1[/IMG]
Date: July 10-August 7
The guild that completes the most amount of quest objectives on the War of Emperium map between War of Emperium battles wins a unique reward.
*Prizes to be announced

[b]King of the Emp[/b]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Ze7sYS6.jpg?1[/IMG]
Date: August 3
For the first three weeks of the War of Emperium Test Month, it’s a free-for-all. Then, on the final week, we hold a tournament for the Top 4 Guilds who have won the most amount of War of Emperiums from the first three weeks.
Each of the four will have a chance to defend against the other three guilds assaulting their fortress.
The guild that defends the longest becomes the Champion, and gets a unique, Grand Prize.
*Prizes to be announced

[b]Grand Melee[/b]
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/oL1nNJV.jpg?1[/IMG]
Date: August 4, 12:00-12:00am PDT (24 hours)
For 24 hours, War of Emperium will rage on continuously, with no win attainable for the full 24 hours.
This will be a grueling competition against the best individual PvPers and PvP guilds. Those who are able to rack up the most amount of player kills and emperium breaks will be rewarded with unique rewards.
Player Grand Prize: Top 20 Players after 24 hours who get the most kills and emperium breaks
Guild Grand Prize: Top 5 Guilds after 24 hours who get the most kills and emperium breaks
*Prizes to be announced

notes.title: Live Stream GM Hide and Seek Event
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

We will be doing a GM Hide and Seek event with the live stream event.

The GM in the live stream will be moving to random locations on the map, and the first FIVE players who are able to find them, take a screenshot, and post the screenshot on our Facebook wall will get a Costume Random Box.

The boxes will be distributed after the event when we can collect all of the winners.
Make sure to include your in-game character name in the screenshot.

There will be five winners selected for each new area the GM moves to.

Come check out the stream at 5pm PDT here: http://www.twitch.tv/warpportal
And post the screenshots on our Facebook here: http://www.facebook.com/PlayRagnarok2

notes.title: *Complete* Patch Notes (6/12/13)
notes.content:
*Complete* June 12, 2013 Ragnarok 2 Patch Notes

1. Kafra Shop
A.	 Following items will be removed from the shop
i. VIP Package (Poring name tag version)
ii. VIP Membership card (1 Day) (Poring name tag version)
iii. Premium Mount Box II
iv. Petit
v. Munil’s Costume Random Box I
vi. Munil’s Accessory random box II
B.	 ‘MD Recommended’ changed to ‘WP Recommended’ / Icon MD was also changed to WP
C.	 Used period for VIP item will be shown in Kafra Shop description.

2. Phantom Cape and Hero Cape can be fused
Following items are acquirable upon fusion:
-	 Angel Wings
-	 Devil Wings
-	 Santa Wings
-	 Santa Bag
-	 Hero Cape
-	 Phantom Cape

3. Items sold during the beta can be fused.
Following items are acquirable upon fusion:
-	 Snorkle
-	 Santa Hat
-	 Santa Wings
-	 Santa Rudolph
-	 Santa Bag
-	 Beach Memory
-	 Vacance
-	 Santa for Man
-	 Santa Lady
4.	 Localization fixes have been implemented.
5.	 Character location info has been added to Character selection screen.
6.	 Rewards system timer has been adjusted to center of window.
7.	 Option to toggle own name, VIP effects, guild, and titles has been added.
8.	 Map Auto-Close bug when talking to an NPC has been fixed.
9.	 The issue that caused players to zone into the Colosseum and immediately die has been resolved.
10. Additional server checks have been implementing for players who were being disconnected when changing zones. This should reduce the chance a player can be disconnected while changing zones.

11. Happy Hour Changes:
Pandora’s Hammer and Mallet Drop
Have a chance to drop off all monsters
New Times: Daily
4am-5am PDT
12pm-1pm PDT
4pm-5pm PDT

Karnium Drop
Has a chance to drop off dungeon and raid bosses
New Time: Daily
12am-1am PDT
8am-9am PDT
8pm-9pm PDT

Additional fixes that may show up in this patch, or will be in the next patch:

1.	 Additional Sound Settings
2.	 Whisper Blocking
3.	 Toggle for other players VIP icon.
a.	 We have shrunk other players VIP icon for right now.

notes.title: Event: Play the Game, Get Rewards to Claim!
notes.content:
[b]Play the Game, Get Rewards to Claim![/b] 

We are introducing a new system that allows you to get rewarded for time spent playing the game.

When you log in on June 5th, you will see a new icon next to your minimap that will show an icon and countdown timer. Once that countdown timer reaches zero, you will earn your first reward!

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Rag2-2013-06-04-13-26-16-82.bmp[/img]

By clicking on the timer, you will be presented with an option to send the item to your Temporary Box Storage. From there, any of the characters on your account can benefit from the item.

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Rag2-2013-06-04-15-22-20-04.bmp[/img]

The countdown timer will keep the same count regardless of what character you decide to switch to on your account.

 

The hourly rewards are the following:

[b]After 1st Hour: Explorer Red Potion x1[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Explorer-Red-Potion-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Explorer-Red-Potion-Description.png[/img]

[b]After 2nd Hour: Spinel Repair Kit x1[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Spinel-Repair-Kit-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Spinel-Repair-Kit-Description.png[/img]

[b]After 3rd Hour: Screw Fin Cocktail x1[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Screw-Fin-Cocktail-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Screw-Fin-Cocktail-Description.png[/img]

For the fourth hour and every hour following, the player will receive another Screw Fin Cocktail.
 

Additionally, there is reward system for players who log in consistently.

For each consecutive day a player logs in, they get closer to more rewards. Players who log in will be presented with the new Attendance Check screen that will show a growing plant, getting closer to the top after each consecutive day they are logged in.

After the first day, you can claim your first reward:

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Rag2-2013-06-04-12-10-41-73.bmp[/img]

After receiving your item for the first day, and logging in the next day, you will see your plant start to reach the next reward:

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Rag2-2013-06-04-12-10-48-81.bmp[/img] 

The rewards for the daily Attendance Check are the following:

[b]After the 1st Day: Wind Elixir x5[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Wind-Elixir-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Wind-Elixir-Description.png[/img]

[b]After the 2nd Day: Red Potion (VI) x10[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Red-Potion-VI-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Red-Potion-VI-Description.png[/img]

[b]After the 3rd Day: Spinel Purple Potion x3[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Spinel-Purple-Potion-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Spinel-Purple-Potion-Description.png[/img] 

[b]After the 4th Day: Movement Speed Elixir x3[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Movement-Speed-Elixir-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Movement-Speed-Elixir-Description.png[/img]

[b]After the 5th Day: Heavenly Sausage x1[/b]

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Heavenly-Sausage-Icon.png[/img]
[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/Heavenly-Sausage-Description.png[/img]

For every day after the 5th day that a player logs in, without missing a day, they will receive another Heavenly Sausage. 

If a player skips a day, then the plant is reset, and they start over. 

We hope this new reward system helps you level your characters, dive into the dungeons, and enjoy the world of Midgard more in Ragnarok 2!

notes.title: Card Synthesis
notes.content:
[b]Card Synthesis[/b]

Card Masters within the game allow players to combine cards in order to have a chance at attaining a rare-quality card.

The first step is to find a Card Master, and buy a Card Synthesis Stone.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HyEYylz.png?1[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/rSGeiqd.png?1[/img]

Then you’ll want to talk to the Card Master again in order to bring up the Combine option.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/c5wLPP4.png?1[/img]

This will finally bring you to the Card Combine window.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BlvpbYA.png?1[/img]

Place your cards in the slots on the top, or right-click them, and then place the card synthesis stone in the bottom.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GHUJC9K.png?1[/img]

Once you hit combine, it will merge the cards into one, and if you are successful it will give you a new card!

 

Card Synthesis has a chance to fail, and the player would receive nothing, but there is an item in the Kafra Shop that would make sure you don’t lose all your cards.

That item is called Card Designated Synthesis.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4awlwEw.png?1[/img]

You can acquire it by itself, or in a bundle box.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XlpHIId.png?1[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/o07fB7x.png?1[/img]

The Card Designated Synthesis item can be placed next to the Card Synthesis Stone.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8k4DANA.png?1[/img]

This allows the player to select a card to save in case of a failed attempt, and gives the player a preview of the rare-quality card they can receive.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hS78QOM.png?1[/img]

Combine, and you have a chance to get a rare card!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FJql4n2.png[/img]

Gather cards, find a Card Master, and start combining!

notes.title: Costume and Accessory Fusion
notes.content:
[b]Costume and Accessory Fusion[/b]

Two new items in the Kafra Shop allow players to combine costumes and accessories in order to get new ones with rune sockets.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fABt3fo.png?1[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/0yWoimr.png?1[/img]

For this example, I will use the Costume Fusion Tablet.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/UpdDri9.png?1[/img]

Once you right-click the Costume Fusion Tablet, you will see the following window:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dckFzkW.png?1[/img]

The three slots at the top are for additional items. These additional items are Appearance Maintain Slate (An ingredient to maintain the appearance of rare costume) and Rune Maintain Slate (An ingredient to maintain the runes inside the costume).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QMXYwW2.png?1[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/v6TLMvV.png?1[/img]


Once you have placed your two costumes, and any additional slates, you will be able to choose if you want a Random costume or select one of the options at the bottom (if you have not used an Appearance Maintain Slate).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xNYNYB8.png?1[/img]

Hit the Combine button, and get your costume! In this case, I used an Appearance Maintain Slate, and was able to keep the appearance of my Gothic Loli costume.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/DIHgCqc.png?1[/img]

notes.title: Unions
notes.content:
[b]Unions[/b]
 

Unions have come to Ragnarok Online 2. Now, level 50 players can choose to ally themselves with one of six different Unions. Once joined with a Union, players can participate in the Union quests to receive Union Points. These points can then be exchanged for unique items, including special Union costumes.

Here are the six Unions players can choose from:

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/union1.png[/img]

Note that you do not have to be of that class to join a union. For example, if you are a Hunter, you can choose to join the Magic Academy Union.

If a Union doesn’t work for you, you can choose to leave a Union. To do so, complete or abandon any Union quests currently accepted, and leave by clicking on “Leave Union” after right-clicking its icon. Remember that if you leave a Union, you cannot re-join or join another Union until 48 hours has passed.

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/quittingunion1.png[/img]

Once you finish quests, you recieve Union Points. You can exchange these points at Union NPCs. 

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/unpt.png[/img]

These are the six different Union costumes you can purchase when you have earned enough Union Points. Note that there are female and male versions of these permanent costumes for each union.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/A28l3c5.jpg?1[/IMG]

Curious to what kind of monsters you would need to hunt and defeat? Here is one to feast your eyes on.

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/rushtank.png[/img] 

And don’t forget about the dungeon bosses.

[img]http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/ungoliant.png[/img] 

Choose your unions wisely!

notes.title: Last Chance for Founder
notes.content: Last Chance for Founder The Founder event is ending on June 1st, but we wanted to make sure you all were able to earn Founder titles for your other non-level 30 characters. From Friday at 12pm PDT to Monday at 12pm PDT, you can earn an additional Founder title to use depending on how many hours you can accumulate in the game. Over the three days, players will earn an additional Founder title for every tier of hours played they can accumulate. Play at least 6 hours = 1 Founder Title Play at least 12 hours = 2 Founder Titles Play at least 24 hours = 3 Founder Titles Play at least 36 hours = 4 Founder Titles Play at least 48 hours = 5 Founder Titles Play at least 60 hours = 6 Founder Titles The accumulated time is for your account, and is not character-bound.

notes.title: Prepare for battle in the Colosseum!
notes.content:
Welcome to the PvP Colosseum! [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ipjciqG.png?1[/IMG] Coming 5/14/13 The PvP Colosseum comes to Ragnarok 2 on May 14, 2013, and provides a ton of player-versus-player excitement. Twice a day, players will hear the call to the Colosseum to do battle. Not only will you be able to do battle against other players and monsters, but you will get to earn points that you can use to acquire unique equipment, costumes, and even a special PvP mount. Colosseum Basics [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ymKzlwd.png?1[/IMG] Thirty Players Enter and Battle for Their Lives… and Points! An announcement for the Colosseum will go out twice a day for characters who are level 25 or above, and an icon will appear on the right side of their screen allowing them to enter the Colosseum.
  • If you are in a group, it will remove you from that group before entering. Players within dungeons will not be able to enter the Colosseum unless they exit the dungeon first.
    • Each Colosseum will put 30 random players (of equal level) against each other for five rounds of battle.
  • Players are warped into the Colosseum and placed randomly between two starting locations.
  • Players HP will be matched to balance the battlefield.
  • Players begin in a Safety Zone where combat is disabled.
  • Players are able to enter the Battle Zone, triggering a Battle status on themselves, and are able to defeat other players to gain rank within the Colosseum.
    • After each round, players will be ranked according to how many players or monsters they defeat. Lower ranked players will be eliminated each round and removed from the Colosseum.
  • Players will receive PvP pooints and a Victory Random Box after each round that they survive. The Victory Random Box will contain useful consumeables.
    • Colosseum Rewards [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Z9uB1cQ.png?1[/IMG] Players will receive points from participating in the Colosseum that can be used to purchase high quality PvP equipment and weapons. Players will be able to find the vendors for these items in Prontera. [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/cuIkb5z.png?1[/IMG] Other unique items that can be bought with PvP points include Refine Stone Box, Union Point Random Box, and even a unique PvP mount that grant a boost skill to improve its speed for a certain time. [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/LXgr5mv.png?1[/IMG] Sharpen your weapons and prepare to do battle in the PvP Colloseum!

notes.title: Regarding Framerate Issues
notes.content: Hi, Steam-powered Midgardians We are aware that many of you are experiencing framerate issues, even with higher end hardware. We have recently discovered that one reason for this might be running Windows Defender at the same time our HackShield runs. If you make the RO2 folder an exception in Windows Defender, it should clear up a lot of the framerate problems that you have been experiencing. For Comcast Players We have also discovered that Comcast players may have a program called Comcast Constant Guard installed, which is causing a lot of the same issues, including sometimes restricting players from logging on successfully. Making an exception for the game within that program might also alleviate the issues it may cause. If neither of these fixes are working for you, please submit a ticket so we can track what specific problems you are having, and can target them in the future. You can submit a ticket here: https://support.warpportal.com/Main/frmNewTicket.aspx?InstanceID=ff93bd48-d0fc-48ea-b407-41c4a79e6592

notes.title: Stuck in game? Try this!
notes.content:
If you find that your character is stuck in game, and is unable to move, there are a couple of things you can try (until we can create a permanent fix):

1. Press the ESC key, and reset all your options.

or

2. Press ALT+TAB to minimize the game, then open it back up.

We have found these two methods have helped players who are having issues moving or interacting with the UI.

If none of these options are working for you, please submit a ticket and one of our support members can help you out:
https://support.warpportal.com/Main/frmNewTicket.aspx?InstanceID=cd6941ff-d3c7-4a95-967f-e7151f4f0d75

notes.title: Regarding Steam Payments
notes.content:
We are aware that some users are experiencing discrepancies when making payments and receiving their points in game. We are actively working on a solution to make sure these types of errors do not happen in the future.

If you feel that you have experiencing an issue when purchasing points in game, the quickest way to get help is to put together a support ticket so that our support team can investigate and issue you the correct amount.

Please include the following information:
1. How many payments are missing?
2. Total points owed?
3. Confirmation Number from Steam
4. Time Stamp on your receipt.
5. Account name/Character name.

You can create a ticket here:
https://support.warpportal.com/Main/frmNewTicket.aspx?InstanceID=cd6941ff-d3c7-4a95-967f-e7151f4f0d75

notes.title: Now Available - Ragnarok Online 2
notes.content:
Ragnarok Online 2 is Now Available on Steam.

Return to the beautiful and dangerous world of Midgard! Inspired by Norse mythology, the much-anticipated sequel to the groundbreaking Ragnarok Online has arrived! Immerse yourself in the new, but recognizable world of Ragnarok 2.

Visit the large, capitol city of Prontera, form a party and explore the underwater Sea Temple dungeon, or set up a shop and earn a living for your character by accepting a job as an Alchemist, Artisan, Blacksmith, or Chef. Adventurers who have explored the world of RO1 will instantly recognize many of the famous monsters and landmarks as their journeys continue. The fun social experiences of character customization, guild creation and PVP play have also returned!

Ragnarok 2 is a free-to-play, fantasy MMORPG that takes elements from the original Ragnarok Online and re-imagines them as a three-dimensional, modern MMO experience.
